jobs.title: Bike Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**
As a CBRE Bike Program Coordinator, you will support the bike program in Mountain View and assist with the implementation of employee commute and transportation programs.
This position is part of the Transportation team, which promotes alternative commuting options and helps reduce single\-occupancy vehicle usage through biking, walking, ridesharing, transit, and other mobility solutions.
This position is onsite five days per week.
**What You'll Do:**
* Rebalance campus bikes throughout the day to ensure availability across all buildings.
* Unlock all campus bikes in the morning and secure them at the end of the day.
* Recover campus bikes from offsite locations as needed.
* Assist with bike upkeep, including cleaning, replacing bike number decals, and identifying bikes that require servicing.
* Support the loaner bike program, including bike sizing, helmet fitting, and rider education.
* Assist with bike\-related events and classes, including Bike to Work Day, demo events, and educational sessions.
* Support the development and implementation of programs that encourage a biking culture across campus.
* Support tours, education sessions, and other transportation\-related activities.
* Follow all transportation, workplace, and safety procedures.
* Complete additional duties as assigned.
 **What You'll Need:**
* High School Diploma or GED required.
* 1\-2 years of transportation\-related experience required.
* Prior bike shop experience preferred.
* Experience with bike sizing and basic bike fitting.
* General understanding of bicycle mechanics and functionality.
* Ability to identify bicycles in need of maintenance or repair.
* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Valid driver's license required.
* Ability to lift up to 40 lbs.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable interacting with employees, visitors, and large groups.
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office products and Google Workspace.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to multitask and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and adaptability.
* Ability to work flexible schedules based on business needs.
* Ability to support operational activities when needed.

  


**Why CBRE**
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact.
Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values of respect, integrity, service, and excellence. We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences and provide opportunities for professional growth and development.
**Our Values in Hiring**
At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.
**Applicant AI Use Disclosure**
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask candidates to disclose any use of AI during the application and interview process.
**Disclaimers**
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $58,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $60,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  

  

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Geotechnical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Romig Engineers, Inc. has been in business for over 30 years and has grown to be a leading geotechnical and geologic engineering firm on the Peninsula for San Francisco Bay Area projects. Since its founding in 1994, the company has successfully completed over 7,000 projects, ranging from residential to high\-rise commercial and municipal developments. Our team of about 30 to 35 staff members includes licensed geotechnical engineers, civil engineers, geologists, field and laboratory technicians, and administrative staff collectively dedicated to delivering practical, cost\-effective solutions with exceptional service.

**Current Opportunity**

We are a growing firm and typically promote from within. At this time, we are looking externally for an engineer local to the area that will be a good fit for our team and is up for the challenge of being a Project Manager at Romig Engineers. An ideal candidate would be someone who has previous experience working on residential, municipal, and commercial projects in the Bay Area.

**Job Summary**

You will be joining our group of 6 engineering project managers, a licensed CEG, and three reviewing principal engineers. Three of the firm owners/experienced principals will be reviewing your work, and you will be working with most, if not all, members of the staff.

This position is structured to support an engineer moving from EIT to California PE registration, or preferably already a licensed Professional Engineer. This role offers a clear path to increasing project and client responsibility, and technical problem solving.

**Responsibilities**

The project manager position at Romig is a well\-rounded role that incorporates technical work, business development, internal leadership and mentoring, and a strong team centered approach. This role requires strong communication skills to work effectively with clients, design professionals, contractors, and Romig staff ranging from the firm’s principals to less experienced employees of the firm performing drilling and/or construction observation. The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

o Interface with clients to understand the project and develop the project scope

o Prepare geotechnical proposals, reports, and plan reviews, and responding to agency review comments.

o Manage the project scope, schedule, and budget from authorization through delivery, which includes

* Managing the site subsurface investigation and laboratory testing programs
* Conducting site reconnaissance for projects with challenging site conditions and/or evaluating signs and causes of distress
* Supervision and logging of subsurface exploration for more complicated projects
* Performing geotechnical analyses and design of shallow and deep foundations, embankments and cuts, earth retaining systems, pavement, landslide repair, and geotechnical aspects of other site features for residential, commercial, and municipal projects
* Performing long\-term and seismic related settlement and slope stability analyses, and developing seismic design parameters

o Providing geotechnical support during design and construction phases, including value engineering with the design team for alternative cost\-effective solutions.

o Work with junior engineering and geology staff to develop and mentor their development

o Work with licensed geologists on projects that include a geologic component

o Work with principal engineers to develop technically and align with the firm’s strategy

o Develop new and maintain existing client relationships

**Ideal Candidate**

o California EIT registration with the ability to obtain CA PE, but preferably current CA PE registration

o 4\+ years of California progressively increasing geotechnical experience, including field and project management experience

o Knowledge of Bay Area practices and local geology; hillside and sloping\-site experience a plus

o B.S. or M.S. in Civil Engineering with geotechnical engineering emphasis

o Strong leadership and decision\-making skills

o Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills

o Self\-motivated with strong interest in career advancement

o Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

o Valid California driver's license

**Compensation Package**

o Competitive salary, range of salary depending on experience

o Quarterly bonus compensation program

o Medical, dental, vision, and long term disability

o 401(k) and Roth 401(k) retirement plan with matching contribution / profit sharing plan

o Paid holidays and PTO (include vacation and sick leave)

o Education allowance

o Professional association and license fee reimbursement

**Details**

Qualified individuals should email their resume and cover letter detailing their prior experience to info@romigengineers.com. For more information about our company, please visit www.romigengineers.com.

*Romig Engineers is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Finance \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


The Pricing \& Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, Finance, and Systems teams to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long\-term scaling of the business.


To thrive in this team, you need to be a proactive problem\-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail\-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high\-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.


**About the Role**


We are looking for a Pricing Operations Lead to help translate pricing and packaging decisions into clear, scalable execution. You will work closely with pricing leaders and cross\-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM to ensure pricing changes are implemented accurately, system requirements are well managed, and launch decisions move from strategy to reality with discipline.


You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of business judgment, systems thinking, and program management. This role will help shape the operating backbone for pricing implementation, support teams developing billing and related monetization systems, and ensure the pricing team's needs are represented clearly in cross\-functional planning and execution.


**In this role, you will:**


* Lead the operational execution of pricing and packaging decisions from approval through implementation and launch
* Translate pricing strategy, policies, and launch decisions into clear business requirements for billing, quoting, revenue, and related systems teams
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM teams to manage dependencies, scope tradeoffs, testing needs, and launch readiness
* Own pricing\-related requirement intake and prioritization on behalf of the pricing team, ensuring requests are clear, well managed, and tied to business needs
* Support the design and implementation of new product, SKU, packaging, and billing configurations as pricing changes move into production
* Establish lightweight but effective pricing operations processes, including governance, documentation, sign\-offs, and issue tracking
* Identify recurring friction in pricing execution and drive improvements that reduce ambiguity, delays, and rework

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Have 6\+ years of experience leading pricing operations or closely related monetization, commercialization, or revenue operations work
* Have a strong track record of helping implement complex pricing or packaging decisions across cross\-functional teams
* Can translate pricing intent into practical system requirements, launch plans, operating workflows, and stakeholder decisions
* Have experience partnering closely with billing systems, product, engineering, finance, and go\-to\-market teams
* Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and timelines at once
* Communicate clearly with both business and technical audiences, and can drive accountability without creating unnecessary process
* Care deeply about operational precision, customer clarity, and building systems that scale as pricing complexity grows
* Are a self\-starter who can roll up your sleeves and operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environment

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**A Snapshot of the Role**


As a Gas Services Account Manager for the West Region, you will serve as the primary Siemens Energy contact for an assigned portfolio of power\-generation customers. You will build trusted relationships, understand each customer’s operational and business priorities, coordinate responses to day\-to\-day needs, and translate those needs into sustainable business opportunities for Siemens Energy. Working across multiple product lines and internal functions, you will lead account strategies, support proposals and contract negotiations, and help customers improve the reliability, availability, performance, and long\-term value of their power\-generation assets.

**Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the following locations: Salt Lake City, UT; Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Seattle, WA; or San Francisco, CA.**

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of power\-generation customers in the West Region, developing trusted relationships across plant operations, maintenance, engineering, procurement, and leadership teams.
* Develop account strategies and lead the sale and negotiation of Gas Services solutions, including spare parts, component repairs, modernizations and upgrades, onsite field services, digital solutions, and long\-term service, alliance, and other service agreements.
* Represent the voice of the customer by sharing market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer feedback with internal stakeholders to support the development and continuous improvement of Siemens Energy Gas Services offerings.
* Plan and lead customer meetings, product and service presentations, site visits, and executive engagements that address customer priorities and advance account opportunities. Coordinate commercial, legal, technical, project\-management, and service teams to develop timely, compliant, and competitive responses to customer requirements, proposals, and contract negotiations.
* Own account plans, opportunity development, sales forecasting, and pipeline accuracy for the assigned customer portfolio, maintaining clear priorities, next steps, and internal alignment. The assigned account portfolio may include customers located in Utah, Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada, Arizona, Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a business\-related field.
* 5\+ years of sales, account\-management, or business\-development experience in the power\-generation industry, preferably involving power\-plant services such as parts, repairs, onsite field services, modernizations and upgrades, and service agreements.
* Strong knowledge of power\-generation equipment and plant operations, including gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators. Strong relationship\-building, communication, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to listen to customers, identify operational and commercial priorities, and convert those insights into effective account and opportunity strategies.
* Ability to communicate account and opportunity strategies clearly, influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority, and align multiple product lines in support of proposals and contract negotiations.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 40–50% and to adjust working hours occasionally for customer events, outage support, or other business needs that may occur during evenings or weekends.
* Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer\-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers.

**About the Team**

**Gas Services**


Gas Services supports customers across the lifecycle of their power\-generation assets, including gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators. Our portfolio includes parts, repairs, field services, modernizations and upgrades, digital solutions, and long\-term service programs designed to improve reliability, availability, efficiency, flexibility, and emissions performance. Through service, modernization, digitalization, and decarbonization solutions, we help customers operate their fleets reliably while advancing their energy\-transition goals.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Rewards**

* Career growth and development opportunities within a supportive work culture
* Company paid Health and wellness benefits
* Paid Time Off and paid holidays
* 401K savings plan with company match
* Family building benefits
* Parental leave


This role may be based in various locations within the assigned West Region (Salt Lake City, UT; Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Seattle, WA; or San Francisco, CA.) sales territory. Siemens Energy offers a variety of health and wellness benefits, including paid time off and holiday pay. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://benefitsatenergy.com/thinking\-of\-joining.html. The base salary range for this position varies by location. For positions based in the United States, the base salary range is $90

jobs.title: Operations Manager-CA
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.


The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short\-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management


Lead others and work effectively with store crews


Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew


Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner


Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement


2\. Customer Service


Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints


Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**
Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.


Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill


Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise  



  

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**
High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


16**Time Type**


Part time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$23\.45 \- $37\.45
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

  

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**


We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.  

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/30/2026
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Sr Strategic Operations Manager, Alcohol Category Growth
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

Grocery \& Retail is a fast\-growing part of Uber Eats, and this role sits at the center of how we identify opportunities, solve problems, and scale the business. We are looking for a Strategic Operations Manager to join our Category Growth organization and drive high\-priority initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
  

  

Depending on the focus area, your work may range from using data to uncover insights and build reporting that informs business decisions, to owning operational programs and cross\-functional initiatives that drive growth and improve the customer and merchant experience.
  

  

You will succeed in this role if you are highly analytical, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and equally willing to develop the strategy and roll up your sleeves to execute it.
  

  

**What You'll Do*** Own high\-priority initiatives end\-to\-end \- define the problem, build a plan, coordinate stakeholders, drive execution, and measure outcomes
* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards \- create trusted views of performance, support recurring business reviews, and help the team understand what is happening and why
* Turn data into insights and action \- analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and synthesize findings into clear recommendations
* Spot gaps and build solutions \- identify where measurement, process, or operating structure is missing or broken, then help create the framework needed to close it
* Collaborate cross\-functionally \- work across teams including Category, Growth, and Marketing to translate business priorities into action, align stakeholders, and unblock execution

**Basic Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in analytics, operations, strategy, business intelligence, project management, or a related field
* Strong SQL proficiency \- comfortable writing queries independently to analyze business performance and answer business questions
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications*** Background in grocery, retail, CPG, e\-commerce, marketplaces, or a related industry
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting in tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for analysis, reporting, and ad hoc work
* Demonstrated ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to own workstreams end\-to\-end and drive execution across stakeholders
* Advanced SQL proficiency and experience working independently with complex datasets
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, automation, and analysis
* Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests and understanding statistical significance
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Tenacious problem\-solver who is comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding a path forward
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Proven ability to balance multiple workstreams and consistently deliver against deadlines in a fast\-paced environment  
* 

  

  

For Chicago, IL\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $118,000 per year \- USD $131,000 per year.  

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

**JOB SUMMARY:**
Overall Summary of Function
The Field Operations Manager oversees the day to day execution of field operations, including installation, strike, and on\-site production of events, ensuring all client work orders are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Blueprint Studios’ quality standards. This role is responsible for managing Field Operations Supervisors, Leads, and installation crews while coordinating labor, logistics, and execution across multiple job sites.


The Field Operations Manager plays a critical role in planning, scheduling, and executing event installations and removals by aligning labor forecasting, trucking logistics, and operational timelines with internal teams including Sales, Production, Shipping, and Labor Coordination. This role ensures all projects are executed according to contract specifications, floorplans, and client expectations while maintaining strong cost control and operational efficiency.


In addition, this role provides leadership, training, and performance management for Field Operations teams, ensuring consistency in execution, safety compliance, and customer service. The Field Operations Manager promotes a culture of accountability, teamwork, and solution driven leadership while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

UC Berkeleys University Health Services (UHS) is a comprehensive college health service providing fully accredited primary medical care, counseling and psychological services, and innovative health promotion programs for students, faculty, and staff. jobs.description:
Operations Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Operations Manager. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. The Operations Manager will champion high‑quality service, workforce stability, and operational consistency by proactively addressing performance concerns, maintaining contractual staffing levels, and building strong client relationships Why Join Allied Universal?
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Selection and Placement* Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first\-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low\-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
* Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch


Schedule and Workforce Management* Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly
* Ensure all positions are staffed according to contract requirements and effectively manage branch overtime through proper scheduling and staffing; maintain a qualified, sufficient pool of flex personnel for backfill of vacant positions as needed
* Maintain regular proactive contact with Security Professionals to ensure all staff is being effectively utilized, properly trained, and ready for placement as needed. Review “No Hours Report” with branch Human Resource staff on a weekly basis, and disposition employees who are on “active” status with no hours, in accordance with company policies, ensuring no employees remain on “no hours” status beyond 3 weeks


Payroll Management* Receive weekly timesheets and update WinTeam schedules as necessary (verify such for self\-scheduling accounts); run weekly payroll according to company procedures. Ensure records are properly maintained and updated to reduce payroll errors; resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely and efficient manner, and communicate status of such to affected employees, to minimize financial exposure for Company
* Follow all company policies regarding timekeeping procedures, meal and rest period breaks (where applicable), ensuring signatures and acknowledgements are properly documented (where applicable), and conducting weekly audits of timekeeping records to ensure accuracy
* Process requests for final paychecks, anniversary bonuses and other pay related issues, and execute the distribution of such pay; act as a Company representative in such matters as unemployment hearings, workers’ compensation hearings/depositions, union meetings (where applicable), state agency activities, depositions, and other related liability matters


Employee Relations* Conduct disciplinary and counseling sessions with Security Professionals as needed in a proactive and professional manner. Ensure all such issues are documented according to company standards, and that all issues receive proper follow up for resolution
* Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
* Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner
* Ensure a smooth running operation by enforcing post specific policies and procedures through proper communication and training; may utilize field training staff to assist in executing post\-specific training

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High School diploma or equivalent
* Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience in a high\-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
* Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
* Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
* Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross\-collaborating and utilizing results\-oriented problem\-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
* Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
* Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision\-making

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in criminal justice, business administration

We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

You will be responsible for balancing high\-impact strategy and ambiguous special projects with running a clean, culture\-oriented business cadence, all while maintaining the trust and authority required to engage directly with executive leadership.


Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

--------------------



Joby Advanced Development designs, develops, and flight\-tests novel aircraft using a software\-first autonomy approach. We build and deploy autonomy, perception, planning, and radar systems across conventional, electric, and hydrogen\-electric aircraft in both CTOL and VTOL configurations.
**Overview**
------------



As a Program Manager in the Advanced Development group, you will directly support the J208 Program Lead in driving execution across multi\-disciplinary engineering teams. You will take primary responsibility for tracking program budgets and schedule performance. In this role, you will work closely with engineering team members to map out schedule logic, identify critical path constraints, and resolve bottlenecks before they impact program milestones.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Track, analyze, and report on J208 program schedule performance and budget health, maintaining accurate forecasting models across engineering workstreams
* Partner directly with engineering teams to map project dependencies, identify critical path activities, and proactively surface schedule bottlenecks
* Integrate with Finance to track program cost performance
* Devise solutions to complex schedule or resource constraints with limited precedent, adapting existing program management frameworks to maintain program momentum
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment across technical hardware, software, and test teams to ensure downstream impacts and interdependencies are understood and managed
* Share program management best practices, concepts, and reporting templates to improve operational efficiency within the Advanced Development team
* Manage project risk registers and actionable mitigation plans, regularly reviewing critical milestones with the Program Lead
* Synthesize conclusions, and recommendations from multiple sources to influence program direction and execution
**Required**
------------


* Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years of experience in program management, project engineering, or technical operations (or Master’s degree with 3\+ years of experience)
* Proven experience building and maintaining complex integrated master schedules (IMS) and tracking program budgets within technical, aerospace, or advanced hardware environments
* Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex engineering workflows to extract critical path items and resource constraints
* Strong communication skills with a track record of successfully working with cross\-functional technical teams to resolve project blockers
  

**This position must meet US export control compliance requirements, therefore a candidate must qualify as a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120\.15\. “US Person” includes US Citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, or asylees.**
**Desired**
-----------


* Experience using modern enterprise program management and schedule tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Smartsheet)
* Familiarity with aerospace development lifecycles, rapid prototyping, or flight test environments
* Hands\-on background in budget forecasting and variance analysis for hardware development programs
* Experience in the development or utilization of military aviation systems

--------------------------

jobs.description:
**Elevate Your Career as a Restoration Project Manager at Dry Kings!**

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in people's lives during challenging times? At Dry Kings Restoration, we specialize in helping property owners restore their homes and businesses after disasters, and we’re looking for a talented and motivated Restoration Project Manager to join our team. This is your opportunity to bring your industry expertise, sales acumen, and problem\-solving skills to a company that values hard work, integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

**As a Restoration Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving our growth and success by acting as the first point of contact for clients, conducting thorough assessments, creating detailed scopes of work, and selling restoration projects.** This position focuses on building trust with clients, delivering on\-time accurate estimates, and ensuring a seamless transition of projects to our Field Team for execution.

**Who We Are:**  
Dry Kings is a woman\- and family\-founded disaster restoration company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We specialize in high\-quality water, fire, and mold mitigation services for residential and commercial properties. Known for our exceptional customer service and high standards, we are proud of our collaborative culture, rapid growth, and commitment to developing our team members. At Dry Kings, you’re not just joining a company—you’re becoming part of a mission to restore more than buildings; we restore lives and communities.

**What You’ll Do:**

***Sales \& Customer Engagement:***

* Serve as the face of Dry Kings Restoration by conducting on\-site inspections and educating clients on industry standards and restoration processes.
* Build trust with customers, identify their unique needs, and provide tailored solutions that align with our high standards of service.
* Secure signed service agreements through persuasive communication and consultative selling, focusing on maintaining high closing ratios.
* Actively follow up with customers to nurture relationships and ensure their satisfaction throughout the process.

***Estimation \& Scoping:***

* Prepare clear, comprehensive, and accurate scopes of work and estimates using Xactimate software, adhering to company standards and industry guidelines.
* Deliver estimates promptly, meeting tight deadlines and exceeding customer expectations.

***Team Handoff \& Collaboration:***

* Collaborate closely with Field Supervisors to ensure a smooth transition of projects from the sales phase to production.
* Provide detailed project documentation to facilitate efficient execution and high\-quality results.

***Reputation Management:***

* Respond promptly and professionally to customer feedback or concerns to protect and enhance Dry Kings’ reputation.
* Demonstrate empathy and problem\-solving skills to turn challenges into opportunities for outstanding service.

**What We’re Looking For:**

***Industry Expertise:***

* Deep knowledge of the restoration industry, including water, fire, and mold mitigation practices.
* Strong proficiency to create precise, actionable scopes and estimates.

***Sales \& Communication Skills:***

* Demonstrated success in consultative selling, with a proven ability to close deals and meet revenue targets.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and relatable way.

***Resilience \& Problem Solving:***

* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* A proactive approach to identifying and solving challenges while maintaining a positive attitude.

***Collaboration \& Leadership:***

* A natural team player who fosters collaboration and contributes to a supportive, high\-performing workplace.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary: $70,000 \- $110,000 per year, plus performance\-based bonuses.
* Comprehensive insurance benefits and other products.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Professional development opportunities to help you grow and advance your career.
* A fun, collaborative, and supportive culture that celebrates achievements and fosters teamwork.

**Other Requirements:**

* A minimum of 4 years of experience in disaster restoration or a related field.
* Certification in WRT, ASD, or equivalent (preferred).
* **REQUIRED: Valid California driver’s license and a clean, insurable driving record.**
* Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs regularly and up to 100 lbs with assistance. Ability to enter confined spaces such as attics and crawlspaces.

At Dry Kings, we value diversity and believe that everyone brings unique strengths to our team. If you’re ready to join a company that’s making a real difference and take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. Let’s restore more than buildings—let’s rebuild lives and communities together.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Lending Technology**

**About CoreVest**


CoreVest is a leading provider of financing solutions for residential real estate investors. Our technology supports the full lending lifecycle—from origination and underwriting through pricing, closing, servicing, treasury, and capital markets.


We are looking for an experienced Project Manager who can bring structure, visibility, and momentum to complex technology initiatives across the CoreVest platform.

**The Opportunity**


As Project Manager, Lending Technology, you will lead the planning and delivery of a portfolio of business\-critical technology initiatives. You will turn strategic priorities into practical, sequenced delivery plans; align demand with internal and vendor capacity; and manage projects from initial planning through launch, adoption, and operational transition.


This is a highly collaborative role that works across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and external partners. You will help teams anticipate dependencies, resolve roadblocks, make informed tradeoffs, and maintain a clear view of scope, timing, resources, budget, and risk.


The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management fundamentals with an understanding of mortgage or real estate lending. You are comfortable moving between executive\-level portfolio discussions and the day\-to\-day details required to keep delivery teams aligned and accountable.

**What You’ll Do**

**Shape the Roadmap**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to translate annual and multiyear priorities into an integrated roadmap of programs, projects, releases, and milestones.
* Lead project intake and initiation by defining business outcomes, scope, success measures, assumptions, constraints, governance, and delivery approach.
* Sequence initiatives based on business value, regulatory commitments, architecture dependencies, operational readiness, risk, and available capacity.
* Develop scenarios and recommendations when priorities, funding, resources, or assumptions change.
* Align project plans with product roadmaps and technology architecture while maintaining clear accountability for delivery.

**Plan Capacity and Resources**

* Build rolling capacity plans using forecasted demand, team availability, delivery velocity, skill requirements, vendor commitments, and production\-support needs.
* Work with functional leaders to assign resources, address capacity or skill gaps, and manage competing priorities.
* Facilitate quarterly and release planning, including what\-if analysis and documented tradeoffs among scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk.
* Develop and maintain project estimates, budgets, forecasts, and variance reporting.
* Manage vendor statements of work, deliverables, invoices, service commitments, and change requests.
* Coordinate resource transitions, onboarding, and knowledge transfer to support both delivery and ongoing operations.

**Lead Complex Delivery**

* Own the project lifecycle from charter and planning through execution, release, operational transition, benefits review, and closeout.
* Create and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, dependency maps, critical\-path analysis, RAID logs, and decision logs.
* Manage multiple concurrent and interdependent initiatives while controlling changes to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate work across internal teams and third parties, including projects involving lending, finance, treasury, capital markets, trading, and enterprise platforms.
* Remove impediments, clarify ownership, secure timely decisions, and escalate unresolved issues with clear options and impact analysis.
* Incorporate architecture, data, security, compliance, testing, controls, and operational readiness into delivery plans.

**Enable Agile and Hybrid Delivery**

* Apply agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery methods based on the needs of each initiative.
* Facilitate planning sessions, standups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other delivery forums.
* Partner with Business Owners and Product Managers to translate requirements into actionable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceable deliverables.
* Support estimation, prioritization, backlog readiness, and shared definitions of ready and done.
* Lead UAT planning, release coordination, cutover, contingency planning, training readiness, hypercare, and transition to support.

**Drive Governance and Executive Visibility**

* Establish clear governance, decision rights, meeting cadence, stage gates, and escalation paths.
* Prepare and lead steering committee and executive reviews covering milestones, spend, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and expected business outcomes.
* Build alignment across Business, Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and vendor stakeholders.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation of decisions, approvals, requirements, testing, releases, and control evidence.
* Coordinate stakeholder communications, training, adoption, and organizational change activities.

**Improve How We Deliver**

* Define and report meaningful delivery measures, including milestone performance, forecast accuracy, capacity utilization, cycle time, throughput, predictability, defects, budget variance, adoption, and benefit realization.
* Create and maintain Jira, Confluence, and project\-planning dashboards that give leaders a current and reliable view of the portfolio.
* Use delivery data, retrospectives, and lessons learned to identify bottlenecks and improve execution.
* Use approved AI and automation tools to streamline planning, documentation, risk identification, meeting summaries, status reporting, and knowledge management while protecting confidential information.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, finance, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent

jobs.description:
**Posting Title:** Senior Project Manager \- Public Infrastructure**Reports To:** Project Executive**Location:** Greater San Francisco Bay Area \| San Jose, CA \|**Salary Range:** $161,250 to $213,000
* ***This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.***

**This position primarily involves working on\-site at the project location or in office. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on the role and project timeline.**
Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**
Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE COMMERCIAL TEAM**Our strong project management teams dedicated in\-house engineering resources and skilled union field staff work together seamlessly to deliver commercial projects that are as innovative and unique as the clients who build them.
**ABOUT THE ROLE****Senior Project Managers** at Cupertino Electric are responsible for the day\-to\-day operations of construction projects and the successful management of a high\-performing team. Senior Project Managers provide internal and external coordination and collaboration with project partners and stakeholders. They are tasked with establishing team member roles and responsibilities and take the lead in defining the structure and communication expectations to ensure efficient work and progression. The Senior Project Manager will lead the team in successfully managing the planning, execution, and financial performance of projects using business practices that are consistent with our company values – people, safety, integrity, innovation, and excellence.
* Provide full ownership of project delivery, including financial performance, schedule adherence, risk management, client satisfaction, and strategic alignment with company objectives.
* Lead multiple complex projects or large flagship projects simultaneously, ensuring all scopes are executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with contract requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for project outcomes, directing Project Managers, APMs, Project Engineers, and coordinating with field leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement across the project team.
* Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans, work breakdown structures, and construction sequencing strategies for complex commercial and industrial projects.
* Oversee procurement strategies, long\-lead planning, subcontractor buyout, staffing plans, and logistics to ensure all project phases are coordinated and fully resourced.
* Review and validate project estimates, budgets, schedules, and contract documents to ensure alignment between preconstruction and operations.
* Ensure the project team understands project constraints, customer expectations, technical requirements, and success criteria.
* Lead risk identification, analysis, and mitigation planning, including design gaps, scope ambiguities, procurement delays, constructability issues, and project\-specific environmental or regulatory risks.
* Maintain and enforce a living risk register, ensuring active monitoring and escalation of issues before they impact cost or schedule.
* Own the financial health of assigned projects, including revenue forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, margin management, cash flow planning, and change order profitability.
* Develop, approve, and/or negotiate all major change orders, subcontractor agreements, and cost adjustments, ensuring alignment with contract requirements and company financial targets.
* Develop detailed monthly job cost reviews, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and early detection of deviations.
* Oversee and support recovery plans for underperforming projects to protect profitability and schedule commitments.
* Interpret, administer, and enforce contract terms, specifications, and commercial requirements for both upstream client contracts and downstream subcontractor agreements.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with clients, owners, general contractors, agencies, and key project partners.
* Mentor and develop Project Managers, APMs, PEs, and field leadership by providing coaching, training, and performance feedback.
* Promote alignment across departments (Engineering, Purchasing, Production, Safety, QA/QC, Accounting) to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support the Superintendent and field leadership in ensuring the project is built according to plans, specifications, and quality standards.
* Drive the company’s safety culture by ensuring planning for safe operations, correcting unsafe behaviors, and supporting incident investigations and corrective actions.
* Serve as a cultural ambassador for CEI, modeling professionalism, integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**ABOUT YOU*** Thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking and reporting principles necessary

**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

  

**About Digital Transformation**

Digital Transformation is a multi\-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI\-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. Key initiatives include Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and enterprise data modernization efforts.


**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.


The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. The role requires strong program leadership, business process expertise, stakeholder management, change leadership, and execution excellence in a global environment.


**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Program Leadership \& Delivery**


	+ Lead large\-scale Digital Transformation initiatives from initiation through deployment and stabilization.
	+ Develop and manage integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource requirements.
	+ Coordinate execution across business functions, technology teams, vendors, and external partners.
	+ Manage program risks, issues, decisions, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID).

jobs.description:
CBRE \| DIRECTLINE, a CBRE Data Center Solutions business, is a leading technology infrastructure services provider enabling mission critical data center infrastructure for the world’s technology leaders. Catering to a broad spectrum of technology and client requirements, 1200\+ skilled technicians deliver over 1000 projects annually across data center markets in the US and APAC. DL has proven success in the deployment of next\-generation infrastructure technologies across the data center lifecycle; from design \& planning, install \& build through Day 2 maintenance, technology upgrades \& retrofits, including delivering the latest wave of AI/ML platforms.

**JOB TITLE: PROJECT MANAGER**

 **About the Job:**


The Project Manager (PM) will be a lead member in our operations team and will drive the delivery of all the various network infrastructure and cabling projects within a particular site. This position will require the individual to have development, management, customer engagement, operational and overall leadership skills.


Key responsibilities will include establishing the program schedule and ensuring the established targets are met regarding schedule, cost, functionality, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.


The role will also include consulting with clients, delivering presentations, resolving project issues, recommendations for new services or enhancements, estimating, proposal writing, project costs management, directing operations on labor requirements, directing/assisting purchasing with bill of materials.


The Project Manager is responsible for the entire successful execution of a project. Their primary responsibilities are to plan, direct, coordinate, and budget activities concerned with the construction of their project. The Project Manager shall also participate and at times lead the conceptual development of a construction project and oversee its organization, estimating, scheduling, and implementation.

**What you will be doing:**

* The project manager is accountable for effective project management and delivery of their projects.
* The PM will work with the extended site team to develop the program schedule and establish key milestones for delivery of the program ensuring all financial targets and schedule targets are met in alignment to the customers' goals.
* The PM will identify and acquire all resources required by revising as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
* During the pre\-construction phase, continuously evaluate the materials and products being proposed for constructability and feasibility. Oversee and at times prepare the cost estimate at multiple stages. Initiate and coordinate the design efforts and the value of engineering processes.

* Determine labor requirements and dispatch workers to construction sites.
* Facilitate travel for technicians traveling to the project site.
* Coordinates with the superintendent.
* Inspect and review projects to monitor compliance with codes and other regulations.
* Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to staff, workers, and clients representing the owner.
* Prepare contracts and negotiate revisions, changes, and additions to contractual agreements with designers, consultants, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors.
* Obtain all necessary permits and licenses.
* Direct and supervise team members in the office and on\-site.
* Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction means and methods.
* Solicit, negotiate, select, contract, and oversee material suppliers, subcontractors who complete specific pieces of the project.
* Requisition of supplies and materials to complete construction projects.
* Prepare and submit budget estimates and progress, and cost tracking reports.
* Develop and implement quality control programs
* Take action to deal with the results of delays, bad weather, or emergencies at the construction site.
* Confer with supervisory personnel, owners, contractors, and designers to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, complaints, and construction problems.
* Plan, organize, and direct activities concerned with the construction and maintenance of structures, facilities, and systems.
* Investigate damage, accidents, or delays at construction sites, to ensure that proper procedures are being carried out.
* Evaluate construction means and methods to determine cost\-effectiveness of plans.
* Manage, cost/budget, and communicate the contract changes process.
* Developing and maintaining the project schedule
* Develop and maintain the project financial plan
* Prepare, maintain, and complete all aspects of the DL Way (project management playbook).
* Completes all weekly and monthly reporting and projections.
* Train and develop project team
* Responsible for timely preparation of billing to Invoice the client
* Equipment and material purchasing
* The Project Manager reviews all job cost postings for accuracy and completeness, including but not limited to, the preparation of invoices, customer collections, and periodic financial reporting to the customer and management.
* The PM will additionally manage all associated aspects of the program including the Safety \& Environment program, the quality assurance program, and material logistics.
* The Project Manager will recruit, hire, train, manage, supervise, promote, discipline and discharge, if necessary, all project related staff.
* The Project Manager will manage all human resource issues (and escalate as needed) per Company policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and partner effectively with internal and external design, construction, network, and facility partners.
* Proactively communicate program status and risks to all stakeholders

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager

This role requires strong technical expertise, exceptional client service skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.  

The Senior Project Manager is a hands\-on delivery leader responsible for developing budgets and schedules, managing contractors and vendors, and ensuring projects meet client expectations for quality, cost, and timing. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with extensive project management experience across multiple sectors who thrives in fast\-paced environments and can maintain excellent client relationships while delivering results. **Key Responsibilities*** Identify, pursue, and secure new project opportunities, leveraging market knowledge to drive business growth.
* Independently develop complete project estimates, proposals, and schedules, and present them effectively to clients.
* Execute subcontractor procurement, including competitive bidding, negotiations, and contract execution.
* Oversee all aspects of subcontractor and vendor performance, ensuring adherence to project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
* Manage full project financials, including billing, budget tracking, change orders, and cost reconciliation.
* Create and maintain project schedules, ensuring timely completion of all milestones.
* Spend substantial time onsite to monitor quality, safety, and progress.
* Maintain proactive communication with clients, setting expectations and resolving issues.
* Represent CBRE with professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client service.

* Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects without dedicated administrative support.

jobs.title: Client Care & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Client Care \& Operations Coordinator – VetnCare**


The Client Care \& Operations Coordinator is a client\-facing customer service role at Golden State Pet Cremation, responsible for supporting families with compassionate communication while accurately handling scheduling, documentation, and day\-to\-day administrative tasks. This role focuses on high\-touch client interaction, careful attention to detail, and reliable follow\-through, working closely with field and facility teams to ensure services are coordinated smoothly and respectfully.

 **A****bout VetnCare:**


Made up of twelve veterinary hospitals situated in Northern California, VetnCare’s vision is to reimagine the local veterinary hospital so our doctors and their teams are empowered to do more advanced care, right here in our own community. Through Golden State Pet Cremation (GSPC), VetnCare supports families with compassionate, dignified end\-of\-life care, honoring the bond between pets and the people who love them.

 **The Role**

* Serve as the primary client contact, providing clear, empathetic communication and timely resolution of questions or concerns.
* Coordinate personalized memorial requests and ensure all client interactions reflect dignity and respect.
* Maintain highly accurate records for cremation services, client files, chain\-of\-custody documentation, inventory, and required documentation.
* Manage scheduling for witnessed cremations, client appointments, drop\-offs, pick\-ups, and internal operational needs.
* Oversee digital and physical filing systems and all correspondence with professionalism and consistency.
* Process payments, generate invoices, support reconciliations, and assist with vendor coordination and required documentation.
* Support daily operations by coordinating field routes, assisting crematorium technicians, and helping with onboarding logistics.
* Maintain inventory, prepare memorial items, and help maintain a clean, organized, and respectful facility environment.

 **About You**

* 3\+ years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, or administrative support, ideally in a high\-touch or sensitive environment.
* Exceptionally organized and detail\-driven, with a track record of managing sensitive information and multi\-step processes without errors.
* Strong, compassionate communicator with experience in high\-touch, client\-facing service environments.
* Thrives in fast\-paced, multi\-step operations and takes initiative to solve problems.
* Collaborative and supportive partner to technicians, field representatives, and leadership.
* Proficient with Google Workspace/Microsoft 365\.
* Committed to delivering respectful, dignified, and high\-quality care to every family.

 **What We Offer**

* Compensation: $22\-$25 per hour
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* 401k
* Supportive and collaborative team environment
* Well\-equipped, clean, and modern facility
* Training and growth opportunities

  

Join a team where your work truly makes a difference. Let’s talk!

jobs.title: Quality Program Manager
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting\-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.


**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

This role will have a high\-profile presence within the Deposition Product Group (DPG) and will drive measurable improvements in business operations through strong quality program management and sustained execution of strategic quality initiatives. The individual will lead cross\-functional quality programs, accelerate 8D cycle\-time reduction, improve supplier failure analysis effectiveness, and proactively advance DPG quality execution. This role will directly contribute to multi\-million\-dollar cost savings that will be reinvested into future growth, product development, and data\-driven business decision\-making, while reducing customer\-visible risk.


**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead and sustain DPG quality strategic initiatives, owning execution cadence, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes across assigned programs.
* Partner with DPG Quality stakeholders and the analytics team to track and manage key KPIs, quality program critical deliverables, identify trends and gaps, and deliver clear, executive\-level reporting.
* Drive alignment across Quality, Engineering, SET, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Suppliers to improve end\-to\-end DPG quality performance.
* Facilitate and lead cross\-functional teams (CFTs) to address systemic quality issues and accelerate the transition from reactive issue management to proactive risk prevention.
* Collaborate with Install \& Warranty and Inventory program managers to analyze data trends and patterns, driving targeted improvements in key performance indicators.
* Expand the impact and maturity of Cost of Quality by correlating I\&W data, ECOGS, and quality events to identify causal relationships and uncover hidden costs across the network.
* Lead and/or advise on multiple concurrent initiatives, demonstrating strong organizational, prioritization, and time\-management skills in a fast\-paced environment.
**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree with 12\+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, or Program Management; Master’s degree with 8\+ years of relevant experience; PhD with 3\+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience and/or PDR experience.
* Semiconductor industry experience required.
* Deep working knowledge of 8D/RCCA methodologies, failure analysis, supplier quality processes, and KPI\-driven performance management, with demonstrated ability to manage high\-complexity workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Proven ability to define clear problem statements and objectives, develop structured analytical approaches, and execute data\-driven analyses to drive decisions and outcomes.
* Strong experience leading cross\-functional teams, demonstrating effective leadership, influence, and accountability to deliver results.
* Ability to influence and drive alignment within a fast\-paced, matrixed, cross\-functional organization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Extensive knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, statistical analysis, and quality systems.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including dashboard utilization and development.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to present conclusions, insights, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* Ownership mindset with a bias for action to drive solutions and positive business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, capable of engaging audiences at multiple organizational levels.
* Willingness and ability to benchmark and adapt best practices to continuously improve quality execution.
**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in semiconductor fabrication, semiconductor equipment operations, or closely related industries is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to improve and evolve processes and methodologies for capturing, structuring, interpreting, and using data effectively.
* Proven success applying structured problem\-solving methodologies and quality tools to resolve complex, multi\-variable problems.
* Hands\-on experience with structured problem\-solving frameworks such as PDCA, DMAIC, and 8D, including practical application of quality tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI dashboard creation and strong data analytics capabilities is a strong advantage.
**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
