jobs.title: Call Center Scheduler, Access, (Novato), Full-Time, Days
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MARINHEALTH**  

Are you looking for a place where you are empowered to bring innovation to reality? Join MarinHealth, an integrated, independent healthcare system with deep roots throughout the North Bay. With a world\-class physician and clinical team, an affiliation with UCSF Health, an ever\-expanding network of clinics, and a new state\-of\-the\-art hospital, MarinHealth is growing quickly. MarinHealth comprises MarinHealth Medical Center, a 327\-bed hospital in Greenbrae, and 55 primary care and specialty clinics in Marin, Sonoma, and Napa Counties. We attract healthcare’s most talented trailblazers who appreciate having the best of both worlds: the pioneering medicine of an academic medical center combined with an independent hospital's personalized, caring touch.


MarinHealth is already realizing the benefits of impressive growth and has consistently earned high praise and accolades, including being Named One of the Top 250 Hospitals Nationwide by Healthgrades, receiving a 5\-star Ranking for Overall Hospital Quality from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and being named the Best Hospital in San Francisco/Marin by Bay Area Parent, among others.

**Company:**

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network**Work Shift:**


Day Shift (United States of America)**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**


40**Job Description Summary:**


The Call Center Scheduler greets patients verbally on the phone and respond to patients in a timely manner. Provides exceptional customer service, to include courteous, helpful, accurate and proactive communication and problem\-solving for patients to ensure that their health care is provided in the most effective and timely manner possible.**Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:**


Pay Range:  

$22\.50 \- $27\.00 \- $31\.50

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Proficiency in typing, filing and aptitude to learn office software
* Good verbal and writing skills and a strong sense of organization
* Team oriented with a strong belief in customer service
* Ability to interpret and apply relevant insurance information when scheduling appointments
* Use EMR/EHR
* Use scanners, copiers and other office equipment
* Knowledge of proper telephone etiquette
* Ability to exercise initiative decision\-making and problem solving
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a busy clinical environment
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently
* Strong organization and verbal communication skills

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* High school diploma required; post\-secondary education preferred.

**Experience:**

* High school diploma required; post\-secondary education preferred.
* Experience with heavy phone volume, scheduling, verifying insurance eligibility, preparing medical records preferred.
* Previous customer service experience preferred.
* Electronic medical records experience preferred.
* Basic computer/keyboard knowledge.
* One year experience in providing customer service either via phone or in person focused on patient care experience
* Ability to type 60 wpm

**Accommodation:**


Qualified applicants with disabilities may request reasonable accommodation during the application process by contacting Human Resources at 415\-925\-7040 or TalentAcquisition@mymarinhealth.org.

 **C.A.R.E.S. Standards:**


MarinHealth seeks candidates ready to model our C.A.R.E.S. standards—Communication, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, Safety—which foster a healing, trust\-based environment for patients and colleagues.

The RCS for Business (RBM) Messaging Spam and Abuse team works on preventing abuse within the RBM ecosystem (Business to user, and User to business).

US: $171000 \- $247000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

jobs.description:
Waldscraft Bakery is looking for a Market Manager to run the logistics and execution of our farmers market and cafe cart sales operations. We currently sell at 7\-8 farmers markets each week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and two on Saturday and Sunday), with a daily café cart launching in the next two months and other growth opportunities in the works. This role is central to making sure the right product, materials, and equipment reach the market, that set up runs smoothly, and that our product displays look amazing.

**What You'll Do**

* Pack \& prep for markets: Pack product for markets. Organize and pack market materials and equipment for each market.
* Deliver: Transport product and materials to market site.
* Set up: booth, displays, and signage at markets with market sales team or independently
* Work Tuesday \& Friday markets: Personally staff the full market window (setup through breakdown) — selling, representing the Waldscraft brand, and handling cash/point\-of\-sale. (This is a tip earning opportunity!)
* Support Saturday \& Sunday markets: Handle setup and restocking during the early, busiest hours alongside the existing weekend team (3–4 staff already cover full\-day sales at weekend markets).
* Return \& Organize: Return to the bakery after each market day and organize the production/materials area for the next day's market
* Manage materials: Own the inventory of market equipment, tents, tables, signage, packaging, and supplies — track what's on hand and what needs replacing
* Build systems: Design and improve a reliable system for organizing and prepping product for delivery — reducing errors, waste, and last\-minute scrambling
* Coordinate scheduling: Work with the Owner to plan which staff are covering which markets each week

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in food/service retail, or a similar hands\-on operational role
* Strong organizational skills — comfortable managing moving parts across multiple locations and days
* A self\-starter who can spot inefficiencies and build a better process, not just follow one
* Reliable transportation and comfort with early mornings and driving a company vehicle to multiple sites
* Ability to lift and carry up to 35 lbs (product crates, tables, tents, equipment)
* Friendly, customer\-facing presence for market days
* Food handler certification (or willingness to obtain one)
* **How to Apply: Please reply to this posting with a resume and introduction telling us about your and why you're interested in joining the Waldscraft team!**

jobs.title: Sr. Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Gusto**



At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.



All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.



AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role**



This is your chance to own one of the most technical, horizontal levers in GTM planning: building the scalable models and infrastructure that enable every route to market to grow efficiently. As Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you'll partner with GTM leaders, Finance, Revenue Operations, and GTM Ops to develop and execute segmentation, book\-of\-business design, quota setting, and capacity planning. You'll turn GTM strategy into concrete, automated models that determine how customers are segmented, how reps are staffed, and what they are held accountable for.



This role takes an end\-to\-end, platform\-minded view across GTM motions, not just a single sales team. You'll identify where manual work, fragmented logic, or inconsistent processes limit scale and build durable planning infrastructure that drives revenue outcomes as the business evolves. You'll own the outcome: balanced books, defensible quotas tied to capacity, and scalable models that hold up under scrutiny.


**About the Team**



You'll sit within GTM Operations, working as the dedicated segmentation, book\-of\-business, and capacity planning owner for our Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales teams. We think of ourselves as builders and problem solvers: we turn ambiguous planning questions into scalable, defensible models, and we hold the line on rigor even when the business is moving fast and priorities compete.



You'll work in close partnership with each organization's GTM leaders and their dedicated GTM Ops partners, leaning on their operational and business context, while you own building, defending, and maintaining the segmentation, book, quota, and headcount models that everyone plans against.


**Here's what you'll do day\-to\-day**


**Segmentation \& Book of Business**


* Own the design and ongoing maintenance of customer/account segmentation for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales, translating org\-level segmentation strategy into concrete, rules\-based models these teams can operate against.
* Build and maintain balanced books of business across reps and teams, accounting for account potential, workload, geography, and product mix; own rebalancing when the business shifts (new hires, departures, territory changes, book splits).
* Set and maintain clear, documented rules for account assignment, routing, and reclassification, and serve as the ruling authority when edge cases or disputes come up.
* Partner with Sales, GTM Ops, and Systems \& Tooling to ensure segmentation and book structures are reflected accurately in Salesforce and downstream systems.


**Quota Setting**


* Own the end\-to\-end quota\-setting process for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: translating top\-down revenue targets into bottoms\-up, capacity\-based quotas by rep, team, and segment.
* Build and maintain the quota models and methodology, ensuring quotas are defensible, equitable across territories/books, and tightly tied to book\-of\-business design and headcount capacity.
* Partner with RTM leaders, Finance, and Sales Compensation to align quotas with comp plans, revenue targets, and business priorities each planning cycle.
* Own quota administration through the cycle: true\-ups for territory or book changes, new\-hire ramp adjustments, and mid\-cycle corrections.


**Headcount \& Capacity Planning**


* Partner with GTM Ops \& Finance on capacity planning for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: modeling the headcount needed to cover segmented books and hit revenue targets, and identifying where the org is over\- or under\-staffed relative to opportunity.
* Build the headcount models that inform hiring plans, partnering with RTM leaders and Finance on timing, sequencing, and prioritization of new roles.
* Continuously monitor capacity against actual book size, productivity, and attrition, flagging gaps or imbalances before they become a problem.
* Own scenario planning for headcount and territory changes (reorgs, new segments, M\&A, product launches), modeling the impact before decisions are made.


**Cross\-functional Partnership \& Communication**


* Partner closely with RTM leaders and their GTM Ops partners across Direct, Expansion, and Benefits to ensure segmentation, book, quota, and capacity decisions reflect real operational context, while retaining ownership of the outcome and the execution.
* Work with GTM Ops, Finance, and Sales Compensation to stay aligned with org\-wide segmentation frameworks, revenue targets, and comp design.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with sales leadership on plan status, tradeoffs, and risk: you're the trusted authority on "how the books, quotas, and headcount are built and why."
* Document methodology and decisions so segmentation, quota, and capacity models are transparent, auditable, and repeatable across planning cycles.


**Here's what we're looking for**


* 5\+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role, with direct, hands\-on experience owning segmentation, territory/book design, quota setting, or headcount/capacity planning; id

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

**What success looks like:**


Meet or exceed ambitious targets for acquisition, activation, and revenue.Improve conversion metrics from initial discovery through provider selection and care initiation.Increase net\-new member activation rates across organic, paid, and partnership channels.Execute high velocity launches with continuous A/B tests with measurable impact on user acquisition.Improve the integration, speed, and performance of the martech stack to accelerate the product\<\>marketing flywheel.

**What you’ll bring:**

jobs.title: Sales Onboarding & Programs Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.


You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

**About the Role**
------------------


Coram AI is growing quickly, with **frequent new\-hire cohorts and an expanding sales organization**, and we’re looking for a Sales Onboarding \& Programs Manager to own and evolve the programs that help our sellers ramp faster and perform at a higher level.


Reporting directly to our Senior Director, Strategy \& Operations, you will own the coordination and delivery of Sales onboarding end to end: managing cohorts, facilitators, certifications, communications, readiness tracking, and the overall new\-hire experience. As we continue to scale, you’ll build the systems and processes that allow us to onboard sellers frequently while maintaining a consistently high bar for customer readiness.


Beyond onboarding, you will design and execute high\-impact sales programs across our **outbound\-heavy sales motion**, helping sellers become stronger at prospecting, pipeline generation, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression. You’ll also support enablement across Coram’s growing **channel motion**, helping ensure sellers understand how to effectively work with and through partners.


You’ll leverage AI, seller performance data, and field insights to identify opportunities, measure program effectiveness, and connect enablement programs to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership and cross\-functional GTM teams to align programs to the highest\-priority business needs.

* Own Sales onboarding from pre\-boarding through ramp, including scheduling, facilitation, SME coordination, certifications, communications, and follow\-up.
* Coordinate and deliver **frequent onboarding cohorts** as the Sales organization continues to grow rapidly.
* Track seller readiness and ramp progress, giving managers clear visibility into where reps are excelling and where additional coaching or support is needed.
* Continuously improve onboarding based on seller performance, manager feedback, new\-hire feedback, and evolving business priorities.
* Build programs that strengthen Coram’s **outbound sales motion**, including prospecting, pipeline generation, cold calling, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression.
* Build and support enablement programs that help sellers effectively navigate Coram’s **channel and partner motion**.
* Partner with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and top\-performing sellers to turn what works in the field into scalable, repeatable plays.
* Define clear success metrics before programs launch and measure impact beyond attendance or completion.
* Use sales data and AI\-powered insights to identify performance gaps, prioritize enablement opportunities, and assess program effectiveness.
* Build scalable processes, playbooks, certifications, and operating rhythms that allow Coram to maintain a high performance bar as the organization grows.
* Facilitate live training, workshops, certifications, and field programs for sellers and sales leaders.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* New hires become customer\-ready and productive faster, even as onboarding cohorts increase in frequency and size.
* Managers have clear visibility into rep readiness, ramp progress, and areas requiring coaching.
* Sellers consistently execute the behaviors required to generate high\-quality outbound pipeline.
* Sales programs drive measurable improvements in seller behavior, pipeline creation, and revenue performance.
* Sellers are equipped to effectively leverage Coram’s direct and channel motions.
* Best practices from top performers become repeatable across the field.
* Enablement programs are measured by business impact, not activity alone.
* Coram can continue scaling its Sales organization without sacrificing onboarding quality or seller readiness.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Programs, Revenue Enablement, Sales Strategy, or a related GTM role.
* Experience owning or supporting B2B SaaS sales onboarding in a **high\-growth environment**.
* Experience supporting an **outbound\-focused sales organization** and a strong understanding of modern prospecting and pipeline\-generation motions.
* Strong program management, facilitation, and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to use sales data to identify performance gaps and measure program impact.
* Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle, from prospecting through close.

* Comfortable facilitating live sessions and working directly with sellers and sales leaders.
* Comfortable building programs and processes while the organization, product, and go\-to\-market motion are evolving quickly.
* Willingness to travel periodically based on onboarding, field, and company needs.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

jobs.title: Theranostics Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
One Physics is expanding its Theranostics Services line to grow their Theranostics portfolio and help healthcare organizations safely and successfully launch and scale radiopharmaceutical programs including Lutetium\-177 (¹⁷⁷Lu), Radium\-223 (²²³Ra), and Fluorine\-18 (¹⁸F) based agents. We are seeking a Theranostics Clinical Program Manager with a Nuclear Medicine Technologist or Health Physicist background to help build and commercialize our Radiation Safety Theranostics services, guide current and prospective clients through theranostics readiness, and represent One Physics as a trusted technical voice in the field.


This is a hybrid clinical/commercial role: part product development, part client education and radiation safety consulting, and part market\-facing thought leadership and business development. The ideal candidate has walked in the shoes of the hospitals and imaging centers we serve as a nuclear medicine technologist, radiation safety officer, or health physicist and wants to apply that expertise to help more sites launch theranostics programs safely and efficiently.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Service \& Product Development**

* Support the development, refinement, and scaling of One Physics’ Radiation Safety Theranostics service offerings, including site\-readiness assessments, shielding and facility design input, and radiation safety program development.
* Partner with internal operational and clinical teams to translate regulatory requirements (NRC, Agreement State, and institutional Radiation Safety Committee standards) into practical, repeatable service offerings.
* Contribute subject\-matter expertise to the design of new offerings, marketing content, and training materials that support client theranostics launches.
**Client Education \& Theranostics Readiness**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to current and prospective clients, educating hospital, imaging center, and health system stakeholders on the clinical, operational, and radiation\-safety requirements for launching or scaling theranostics services.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual readiness assessments and radiation safety testing for SPECT/Nuclear Medicine and other nuclear medicine modalities (e.g., dose calibrator checks, survey meter calibration verification, shielding/leak surveys, camera/collimator setup review) to support new radiopharmaceutical program launches.
* Guide clients through the practical steps of launching radiopharmaceutical programs, drawing on direct experience with agents such as ¹⁷⁷Lu\-based therapies (e.g., Lutathera®), ²²³Ra , and ¹⁸F diagnostic agents.
* Develop and deliver training content, in\-services, and readiness checklists for nuclear medicine technologists, radiation safety officers, and hospital administration.

As a **Referral PCC**, you will be the first point of contact for patients referred to Talkiatry by our trusted network of partners, and you'll also manage the outbound side of referrals \- coordinating when Talkiatry patients need to be referred out to partner organizations for services outside our scope of care. 8:00am\-4:30pm EST


10:30am\-7:00pm EST

-------------------


Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high\-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co\-founded by a patient and a triple\-board\-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology\-powered, in\-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750\+ psychiatrists, 250\+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

-------------


* **Inbound Referral Outreach \& Scheduling**


	+ Manage referral workflow by initiating outreach on all referrals not yet scheduled and tracking outcomes accurately
	+ Manage a high volume of outbound calls in a fast\-paced environment
	+ Contact referred patients via phone, text, and email to explain next steps, highlight the value of care with Talkiatry, and assist with scheduling
	+ Use motivational interviewing techniques to address concerns, build urgency, and motivate patients to schedule their psychiatric evaluations
	+ Coordinate scheduling using internal scheduling tools and match patients with appropriate Talkiatry psychiatrists based on need, geography, and insurance
	+ Send self\-scheduling links, follow up, and troubleshoot scheduling barriers (insurance questions, availability, etc.)
* **Outbound Referral Coordination**


	+ Manage the outbound referral process for Talkiatry patients being referred to partner organizations for services outside Talkiatry's scope of care (e.g., higher level of care, specialized programs, community resources)
	+ Communicate directly with patients about the outbound referral: explaining why the referral is being made, what to expect, and next steps for connecting with the receiving partner
	+ Coordinate with the partner organization to confirm receipt of the referral, submit any required documentation, and track the patient's status through intake
	+ Keep the Talkiatry referring provider updated on the status of the outbound referral, including confirmation of receipt, scheduling outcomes, and any barriers encountered
	+ Follow up with patients and partners to close the loop on outbound referrals, ensuring patients don't fall through the cracks between organizations
	+ Document all outbound referral activity accurately in internal systems to maintain a clear audit trail for the care team

* 1–3 years' experience in healthcare coordination, patient intake, call center, or referrals
* Experience coordinating care or referrals across multiple organizations or provider networks a plus
* Ability to communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing
* Sales or customer retention experience strongly preferred (e.g., upselling, rebooking, or high\-volume conversion roles)
* Strong phone presence, empathy, and a persuasive communication style
* Comfortable working with CRMs, EHRs (eClinicalWorks), ticketing systems (Zendesk/ServiceNow)
* Ability to multitask and work efficiently in high\-volume environments
* Must be organized, responsive, and detail\-oriented with strong follow\-through

* Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast\-paced startup
* Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

jobs.title: Digital Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**


Lumistry serves over 9,000 pharmacies globally, helping them transform their businesses to improve adherence, reduce operating costs and increase revenue. We offer a collection of solutions purpose\-built for pharmacies, enabling our customers to engage with their patients, consolidate vendors, improve patient health literacy, automate tasks and initiate online scheduling for programs and services. For more information, visit lumistry.com.

### **The Opportunity**


As a Digital Implementation Specialist, you'll build, review, test, and launch the websites and digital products our pharmacy customers rely on. Your job is to make sure every site is accurate, functional, polished, and ready for launch. You'll also keep Digital operations running day to day, from setting up domain\-based email to handling product teardowns. You'll do well if you love details, take ownership, and keep work moving without lowering the bar. You'll find and fix issues, improve our processes, and look for ways to make Lumistry's Digital products easier to use and better for customers. Our goal is for every Digital product and service to be delivered accurately, consistently, and at the quality our customers expect.

### **What You'll Own**

**Website Delivery and Support**

* Build and deploy customer websites in Replit, following Lumistry standards, build processes, and customer requirements.
* Review completed builds for visual accuracy, layout consistency, and content quality, and make adjustments as needed.
* Migrate content, imagery, services, and functionality from customers' existing websites, and resolve anything missing or inconsistent before launch.
* Test functionality and responsiveness on desktop and mobile, including navigation, links, forms, integrations, and other interactive elements.
* Hold every site to our QA standards while finding ways to improve design, usability, accessibility, and the visitor experience.
* Support enterprise and non\-enterprise projects, including large\-scale website migrations and other Digital initiatives.
* Help create, test, and improve website templates, standards, and build resources.
* Meet production goals, timelines, quality expectations, and SLAs.

**Digital Operations and Cross\-Functional Support**

* Create and configure domain\-based Google email inboxes for customers during onboarding and ongoing support.
* Monitor and complete Digital teardown requests so websites and their associated services are properly disconnected or removed.
* Identify and escalate blockers, dependencies, or issues that could affect customer timelines or service delivery.
* Monitor your assigned Salesforce queues so requests keep moving and SLAs are met.
* Maintain internal documentation and support cross\-functional onboarding and training on Digital products and processes.
* Take part in audits, migrations, and special projects as assigned by Digital leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Experience creating, editing, or maintaining websites
* Experience using AI\-powered tools, and real comfort adopting new technology
* Strong attention to detail, with an eye for visual, content, and functional inconsistencies
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, queues, and priorities at once
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and learn new technical tools and processes on your own
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-moving, evolving environment
* A track record of meeting deadlines and production and service\-level expectations
* Ability to collaborate across technical and customer\-facing teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with Replit and Salesforce
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards, responsive web design, and SEO best practices
* Experience in a queue\-based or production\-oriented environment

### **Compensation**


The approximate range for this role is $58,000 to $62,000, depending on experience and skills.

### **Benefits**


Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long\-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**


Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**


We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, M&A & Large Projects
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced senior project manager who can lead M\&A projects as well as other large, complex projects? Do you thrive in environments with many moving pieces, competing priorities, and high visibility? Do you enjoy leading cross\-functional initiatives, building trust with stakeholders, and helping teams navigate ambiguity to deliver outstanding results?



If so, we’d love to hear from you!



Grant Street Group is an innovative and rapidly growing software company that supports government agencies and financial institutions through specialized SaaS solutions focused on tax collection, electronic payments, and more. Our work is meaningful, complex, and highly collaborative — and we are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead large, high\-impact implementation programs across multiple clients and teams. The project portfolio may include mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and integrations, as well as other major business initiatives. M\&A work is anticipated, though it may not begin immediately; this role will lead other strategic projects as business priorities require.



This is not a coordination\-only role. We are seeking someone who can independently lead complex initiatives from planning to execution, drive M\&A\-related work forward, manage risk proactively, align stakeholders, and adapt to shifting priorities.

  


### **What You'll Do**

* Lead project management for mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, integrations, and other major cross\-functional projects from early planning through successful execution
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, workstreams, milestones, and decision logs across multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams across finance, legal, HR, product, engineering, operations, security, leadership, and external partners
* Support due diligence efforts by organizing data requests, tracking open items, coordinating stakeholders, and maintaining momentum across workstreams
* Help drive integration planning and execution, including readiness activities, dependency management, and post\-close follow\-through
* Identify risks, dependencies, blockers, and decision points early and proactively drive resolution strategies
* Facilitate executive\-level communication, status reporting, governance meetings, and stakeholder alignment
* Manage competing priorities across multiple workstreams while maintaining visibility into overall project health
* Drive accountability across teams while fostering collaboration, trust, and clarity
* Help improve internal M\&A processes, integration playbooks, and operational best practices
* Support teams through changing priorities and evolving business needs with a calm, solutions\-oriented approach
* Travel up to 35% as needed based on project requirements

### **What We're Looking For**



Successful candidates will bring strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills along with experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives related to mergers and acquisitions, integrations, enterprise transformation, or similarly complex business operations.


#### **Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of project/program management experience in M\&A, corporate development, consulting, financial services, enterprise technology, operations, or similarly complex environments
* Prior experience leading an M\&A project
* Experience leading or supporting merger, acquisition, integration, or other high\-visibility cross\-functional initiatives
* Ability to operate independently in fast\-moving environments with evolving priorities
* Excel at building alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly and simply to executives, teams, and external partners
* Sound judgment and discretion when managing sensitive or confidential initiatives
* Experience managing projects involving multiple systems, functions, vendors, and cross\-functional dependencies
* A highly organized, flexible and pragmatic approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands\-on execution
* Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they become roadblocks
* Experience recovering or stabilizing challenged projects/programs or navigating ambiguity during periods of organizational change

#### **Preferred Experience**


* Experience with due diligence coordination, integration planning, and post\-close execution
* Experience with change management, process improvement, or operational integration efforts
* Experience in SaaS, software, financial services, or other regulated industries
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams
* PMP or related project management certifications are welcome but not required
### **Why Grant Street Group?**



We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Our company is structured to support remote work, and we’ve built a culture centered on responsiveness, collaboration, trust, and delivering exceptional service to our clients.



Our strongest project managers are empowered to lead independently, solve meaningful problems, and help shape how work gets done. You’ll work alongside talented, supportive colleagues who care deeply about delivering results and helping one another succeed.



If you’re looking for an opportunity to lead meaningful, high\-impact initiatives with a company that values ownership, curiosity, and collaboration, we encourage you to apply.


*Expected Salary Range: $150,000 – $250,000/year*


*Compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and overall qualifications.*

jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**

The Acquisition Training Specialist V provides acquisition training materials, maintains training databases, operates the Learning Management System (LMS), conducts training, collects and analyzes training class feedback, responds to Service Desk inquiries that require training refresher, and creates desk guides.  



  

**Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc.** serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long\-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical \- Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.  



As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug\-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.  



  

All candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance, as well as pass a drug screen and background check.  



  

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS**

Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.  



Expert\-level experience leading acquisition, procurement, contracting, or federal training programs.  



  

Expert knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) including the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul. Experience with Navy Marine Corps Acquisition Regulation Supplement (NMCARS), Other Transaction Authority (OTAs), and Construction contracts.  



Demonstrates the ability to design and manage complex training strategies and curriculum frameworks.  



Demonstrates deep understanding of acquisition processes, procurement policy, and adult learning methodologies.  



  

Maintaining content in Atlassian Confluence, Navy Electronic Procurement System (ePS) (or similar contract writing system), Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) applications (to include Clause Logic Service), and Cornerstone LMS.  



  

Understanding of various acquisition methods and contract types, including commercial and non\-commercial acquisitions, fixed\-price contracts, and cost\-reimbursement contract types.  



  

Acquisition lifecycle expertise to include contract closeout and unliquidated obligation (ULO) modification procedures.  



**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  



Creates acquisition training material, maintain training database, conduct training, respond to Service Desk inquiries that require training refresher, create desk guides.  



  

Manages training logistics, advertise training opportunities to stakeholders, operate the Learning Management System (LMS), and collect and analyze training class feedback.  



  

Quickly digest procurement policy updates from the Department of the Navy (DON) and Department of War (DOW) and create relevant, concise, applicable, and engaging training courses and self\-help materials or videos to train staff and keep them abreast of the ever\-changing regulations.  



  

Leads the overall strategy, planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of acquisition training programs.  



Serves as a senior advisor for acquisition training needs, curriculum design, training modernization, and workforce learning solutions.  



Oversees creation of high\-impact training courses, desk guides, self\-help tools, videos, job aids, FAQs, and other performance\-support materials.

Establishes standards for training content quality, instructional design, LMS usage, feedback analysis, and training records management.  



Leads cross\-functional collaboration with acquisition leadership, policy teams, system owners, Service Desk teams, and subject matter experts.  



Oversees LMS course architecture, catalog management, reporting strategy, training completion tracking, and data quality.  



Uses training metrics, feedback results, Service Desk trends, and stakeholder input to identify learning gaps and recommend program improvements.  



Leads major training rollouts related to policy updates, system changes, process improvements, or acquisition workforce initiatives.  



Mentors and guides training specialists across all levels.  



Develops executive\-level reports, briefings, dashboards, and recommendations related to training performance and workforce readiness.  



Supports continuous improvement, innovation, and modernization of training delivery methods, including eLearning, microlearning, virtual instruction, and self\-service resources.

jobs.title: Vertical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI\-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

  

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250\+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

  

The *Vertical Operations Manager* is accountable for the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This role ensures sales commitments are executable by Operations and delivered to customers reliably and efficiently within defined SLAs.

 **A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

**﻿**

* Operational Accountability: Ensure the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This includes delivering installations on time, maintaining SLA compliance, scaling delivery capacity, and achieving target costs.
* Delivery \& Support Ownership: Oversee all aspects of planning, resource allocation, safety compliance, and quality for installations, maintenance activities. Ensure installation targets are met: 2 days for Rental/Dealership installations and 4 days for Fleet installations. Ensure that maintenance (support visits) have a clear scope of work to complete on time, with a first time right approach.
* Sales\-Operations Interface: Act as the operational counterpart to the Sales and Implementation teams. This involves confirming the feasibility of sales commitments, identifying associated risks, and translating those commitments into concrete, executable operational plans.
* Field Service Leadership: Manager Field Service Engineers and Service Operations Coordinators, focusing on achieving 80% utilization, ensuring technical readiness, and developing productive capacity planning.
* Vendor Oversight: Manage installation partners and contractors. Responsibilities include continuously monitoring and evaluating vendor performance across key areas like cost, quality, and execution.
* KPI \& OKR Management: Proactively achieve critical operations metrics, including on\-time delivery, first\-time fix rates, and target cost per install, by implementing proactive corrective actions.

  

Requirements:
  

* 5\+ years of experience leading field operations, service delivery, or technical operations teams.
* Experience managing distributed Field Service Engineers (FSEs) or technical field teams.
* Experience in the automotive, fleet, rental, dealership, or a similar operational environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Operations.
* Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational forecasting.
* Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.
* Experience managing high\-volume deployment, installation, or field service projects.
* Experience managing third\-party vendors, contractors, and installation partners.
* Proficiency with ERP, CRM, or Field Service Management (FSM) systems to manage operations and drive performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven problem\-solving skills with the ability to make operational decisions using metrics.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certifications are a plus.
* Travel to on\-site locations based on business flow.

 **Benefits we offer:**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, Company paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

 **Compensation:**


UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $125,000\. In addition, this position is also eligible for Bonus.

 **Physical Requirements:**


This role may involve on\-site or field\-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; and performing occasional manual tasks such as lifting or carrying up to 40 lbs, bending, or reaching. The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

 **Why UVeye:**

* Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting\-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
* Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships.

jobs.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI\-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

  

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250\+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

  

The *Vertical Operations Manager* is accountable for the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This role ensures sales commitments are executable by Operations and delivered to customers reliably and efficiently within defined SLAs.

 **A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

**﻿**

* Operational Accountability: Ensure the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This includes delivering installations on time, maintaining SLA compliance, scaling delivery capacity, and achieving target costs.
* Delivery \& Support Ownership: Oversee all aspects of planning, resource allocation, safety compliance, and quality for installations, maintenance activities. Ensure installation targets are met: 2 days for Rental/Dealership installations and 4 days for Fleet installations. Ensure that maintenance (support visits) have a clear scope of work to complete on time, with a first time right approach.
* Sales\-Operations Interface: Act as the operational counterpart to the Sales and Implementation teams. This involves confirming the feasibility of sales commitments, identifying associated risks, and translating those commitments into concrete, executable operational plans.
* Field Service Leadership: Manager Field Service Engineers and Service Operations Coordinators, focusing on achieving 80% utilization, ensuring technical readiness, and developing productive capacity planning.
* Vendor Oversight: Manage installation partners and contractors. Responsibilities include continuously monitoring and evaluating vendor performance across key areas like cost, quality, and execution.
* KPI \& OKR Management: Proactively achieve critical operations metrics, including on\-time delivery, first\-time fix rates, and target cost per install, by implementing proactive corrective actions.

  

Requirements:
  

* 5\+ years of experience leading field operations, service delivery, or technical operations teams.
* Experience managing distributed Field Service Engineers (FSEs) or technical field teams.
* Experience in the automotive, fleet, rental, dealership, or a similar operational environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Operations.
* Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational forecasting.
* Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.
* Experience managing high\-volume deployment, installation, or field service projects.
* Experience managing third\-party vendors, contractors, and installation partners.
* Proficiency with ERP, CRM, or Field Service Management (FSM) systems to manage operations and drive performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven problem\-solving skills with the ability to make operational decisions using metrics.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certifications are a plus.
* Travel to on\-site locations based on business flow.

 **Benefits we offer:**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, Company paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

 **Compensation:**


UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $125,000\. In addition, this position is also eligible for Bonus.

 **Physical Requirements:**


This role may involve on\-site or field\-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; and performing occasional manual tasks such as lifting or carrying up to 40 lbs, bending, or reaching. The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

 **Why UVeye:**

* Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting\-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
* Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company**



Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.



With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.



Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

 **About the Role**



We are seeking a Senior Sales Strategy \& Operations Manager to own the go\-to\-market operating cadence for Armada's global sales organization. This role sits within the Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Director, Sales Operations. This role will serve as a key business partner to Sales Leadership, Finance, Deal Desk, and members of the larger RevOps team, ensuring that our sales organization is optimized for scale, efficiency, and predictable growth across our suite of offerings. It serves as the operational backbone for territory and capacity planning, forecasting, pipeline management, and sales performance reporting across our hardware and software portfolio.



The role carries two mandates. The first is the recurring operating rhythm of the business: forecast management, pipeline inspection, territory design and calibration, quota allocation, and the reporting sales leadership runs the business on. The second is transition support as Armada's business units evolve, including planning for evolving or new lines of business and the territory, quota, and compensation that accompanies it.



This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants ownership of key planning workstreams rather than a narrow analytical lane. The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, thrives in ambiguity, and drives to decisions quickly. You'll join at a pivotal moment, helping build the operating model that scales Armada's sales organization as it brings edge AI infrastructure to customers around the world.

  



**Location.** This role is remote\-based on the continental US.

  




**What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)**


* Partner with sales leadership on regional GTM strategies, providing analysis and recommendations that inform planning and execution
* Support monthly and quarterly business reviews, translating performance data into clear narratives and recommended actions
* Maintain and refine the reporting structure and format sales leadership depends on, including dashboards and recurring deliverables, and recommend definitions of core revenue metrics
* Own the forecast operating rhythm for business unit(s): call preparation, roll\-up, commit and category hygiene, and forecast accuracy tracking over time
* Drive pipeline hygiene and the inspection cadence across regions and business units
* Build capacity, headcount and ramp models that size the sales organization against revenue targets
* Design, build and calibrate territory structure in partnership with sales leadership, and allocate quota against approved coverage models
* Maintain account plans and target account definitions in partnership with regional leaders
* Own go\-to\-market roster management, ensuring joiners, movers and leavers are reflected in payee records, plan assignment and quota allocation
* Partner on segmentation and coverage model design, building the analysis and options that inform coverage decisions
* Develop compensation scenarios and market benchmarking to support plan design
* Administer the sales compensation platform, including plan configuration, period close and payout validation
* Support business unit evolution and creation, including territory and quota re\-cuts, compensation plan migration, roster splits, and data and systems separation inputs
* Apply AI tools and automation in support of GTM strategy, and to accelerate recurring analysis and reporting
* Partner with RevOps, Accounting and Finance, People, and Engineering teams with clear ownership boundaries across each

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree required; a Master's Degree may substitute for two years of experience
* 8\+ years of experience in sales strategy, sales operations, revenue operations or an equivalent analytical function; consulting, banking and corporate strategy backgrounds welcome
* Demonstrated ownership of territory design, quota allocation, capacity modeling and forecast management
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including modeling, pivot tables and formula\-driven analysis
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM
* Ability to translate complex, ambiguous analysis into concise narratives for senior leaders, and to influence and persuade key partners outside your own function
* Comfort operating with limited structure, and a builder's instinct for establishing process where none exists
* Demonstrated discretion handling compensation and other sensitive data

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting multi\-vertical, multi\-geography sales teams that sell both hardware and software
* Experience supporting complex, multiparty sales motions to critical heavy industrial or defense customers
* Hands\-on experience with a sales compensation platform such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly or Spiff
* Experience supporting a business unit creation or separatio

jobs.title: Sr Sales and Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
DaySmart supercharges experienced\-based businesses with innovative, industry\-specific software services that power customer and revenue growth. With thousands of partners worldwide and dozens of industry awards, we provide best\-in\-class solutions to accelerate their business.


**About the Role**  

DaySmart Recreation is looking for a hands\-on Sales \& Revenue Operations leader to help our sales teams operate with greater clarity, consistency and efficiency across our portfolio of recreation software businesses.  

Supporting Sawyer, TeamUp and Dash, this person will be a key operating partner to Recreation leadership and our Sales and Marketing teams. You will own the sales forecast, pipeline discipline, sales process and operating cadence that help us understand performance, identify gaps early, improve seller productivity and make better decisions about where to focus.

  

  

You will not be doing this alone. Core sales reporting and scorecards are being built by a dedicated data team, and day\-to\-day CRM administration is handled by our systems partner. Your job is to put those inputs to work: interpret what the numbers are saying, decide what should change, and drive the fix with sales leaders.

  

  

This is an individual\-contributor leadership role. We are looking for someone who can move easily between analysis and execution — from diagnosing why conversion changed or tightening the forecast to redesigning a qualification step or helping a sales leader see where their team is losing opportunities.  

The goal is simple: help our teams sell more effectively and give leadership a clear, actionable view of what is happening across the revenue funnel.

  

  

**What You'll Own**


* **Sales Performance \& Operating Rhythm**
	+ Partner with sales leaders to identify performance gaps, understand root causes and establish clear actions.
	+ Lead monthly sales performance reviews and support broader Recreation operating reviews.
	+ Translate the reporting and scorecards produced by the data team into a clear narrative for leadership: what moved, why, and what we are doing about it.
* **Forecasting \& Pipeline**
	+ Own and continually improve the sales forecasting process.
	+ Establish consistent pipeline definitions, stage criteria, hygiene standards and inspection processes.
	+ Partner with sales leaders on pipeline coverage, rep productivity, quotas and capacity, working with the data team on the underlying analysis.
	+ Identify bottlenecks and leakage throughout the sales funnel and recommend changes to improve conversion.
	+ Help leadership understand where we are likely to outperform or miss before the results happen.
* **Sales Process \& Productivity**
	+ Identify opportunities to simplify processes and help sellers spend more time selling.
	+ Design and implement improvements across lead management, qualification, demos, follow\-up, pipeline management and closing.
	+ Standardize best practices where appropriate across Sawyer, TeamUp and Dash while recognizing the differences between each business.
	+ Evaluate tools, automation and AI capabilities that can meaningfully improve seller productivity.
	+ Create scalable processes rather than relying on manual work or individual knowledge.
* **Marketing \& Sales Funnel**
	+ Partner closely with Marketing to understand lead volume, quality, attribution and conversion.
	+ Analyze performance by acquisition channel and identify where funnel performance is improving or deteriorating.
	+ Help design and measure GTM experiments across forms, segmentation, demo/trial flows and sales motions.
	+ Ensure Sales teams understand Demand Generation initiatives and have visibility into what is driving their pipeline.
* **Systems \& Data Partnership**
	+ Act as the voice of Sales to the data team and our CRM/systems partner: define requirements, prioritize requests and make sure what gets built solves real seller and leadership problems.
	+ Own the business definitions behind key sales metrics so the data team, Finance and sales leaders are working from the same numbers.
	+ Flag where systems or data quality are creating friction for sellers and drive the fix through the right owner.
* **Planning \& Strategic Analysis**
	+ Support annual and quarterly sales planning, including targets, quotas, headcount, capacity and productivity assumptions.
	+ Build models and analyses to support investment and resource decisions.
	+ Partner with Finance to align sales forecasts and revenue plans.
	+ Turn data into clear recommendations — not simply dashboards.

**About You**


* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations or a related role, with at least some of that time owning forecasting or pipeline for a sales team.
* Experience supporting SMB SaaS sales organizations, ideally with high\-volume inbound sales motions.
* Deep understanding of sales funnels, pipeline management, forecasting, rep productivity and SaaS metrics.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot or similar) and how sales processes are configured within them; you do not need to be the administrator, but you need to know what good looks like.
* Highly analytical with the ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes and translate analysis into action.
* Experience working closely with Demand Generation and understanding lead management, attribution and funnel conversion.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with BI tools and GTM technology.
* Experience using automation and AI to improve GTM productivity is a plus.
* Clear, concise communicator who can present findings and recommendations to senior business leaders.
* Comfortable getting into the details — you do not believe Revenue Operations should operate from a dashboard alone.
* A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-moving environment and can bring structure to ambiguity.
* Strong judgment and a bias toward simple, scalable solutions.

We are motivated by a collective desire to drive the legal industry to the forefront of innovation. With over 2,500 clients around the world, including 95 of the top AmLaw 100 firms, we are changing the outside perception of the legal sphere; where there was once resistance to modernization, we are creating a culture that embraces new ideas and technology.


At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the “A”. We bring the “A” to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward.


Our people are our strength.


**Role Description:**

The Project Manager’s primary responsibility is to manage multiple mid\-size to large projects simultaneously and coordinate with all levels of staff and stakeholders across firms who will benefit from our comprehensive solutions. This is an excellent opportunity to work for a cutting edge, global, and legal software company. If you have a background in one of the following, we would love to speak with you.


* Experience in Global accounting
* Implementation or working experience with ERP systems
* Law firm practical experience including client facing, support, and administrative
* A proven track record of successful project implementation in a software environment
Experience leading complex software implementations for the full project life cycle  
*

* Leading the planning and implementation of the project
* Facilitating the definition of project scope, goals, and deliverables
* Defining project tasks and resource requirements
* Developing project plans
* Assembling and coordinating project staff
* Managing project budget
* Managing project resource allocation
* Planning and scheduling project timelines
* Tracking project deliverables using the appropriate CRM and Professional Services Automation tools on a daily basis
* Providing direction and support to the project team
* Monitoring and reporting on progress of the project to all stakeholders
* Presenting reports defining project progress, problems, and solutions
* Implementing and managing project changes and interventions to achieve project goals
Evaluating projects and assessing results  
* 

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required
* 4\+ years experience leading complex software implementations for the full project life cycle
* A proven track record of successful project implementation in a software environment
* Project Team management experience
* Excellent client facing skills
* Experience using project management tools such as MS Project and Professional Services Automation tools

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Breaktime Media**


We help shoppers figure out what to buy and where to buy it. We build highly personalized, engaging content for the world's biggest CPG brands, with a focus on commerce conversion. Our work runs across retail media networks, brand sites, and loyalty ecosystems, and it reaches millions of shoppers making real decisions.


### **The role**


Breaktime is scaling, and our most ambitious work sits in promotions, loyalty hubs, retail media work and new innovation programs. We ran roughly 30 of these programs this year, they keep getting bigger, and the appetite from our brand partners is only growing. These are the programs that move the needle for our clients and for us.


We're building a dedicated program management role to match that ambition. You will own how these programs get executed: the plan, the deadlines, the dependencies, and the accountability that makes it all come together. Not the client relationship and not the creative, but the operating system across it all.


You will report to our Associate Director, Program Management, who will train you directly and work with you to build out a focused process and ramp you up on a set of programs. You will have real ownership from the start, and room to shape how this function works as we grow.


### **What you'll own**


* End to end program management for promotions, sweepstakes, loyalty hubs, omni retail media programs and custom programs that go beyond our standard content units
* Building and maintaining program timelines, from sold to live to wrap, with clear owners and dates at every step
* Task ownership across internal teams, so client services, creative, marketing and development all know what they owe and when
* Running program status meetings and keeping stakeholders honest about risk before it becomes a problem
* Partnering with client services on kickoff calls and status calls for our most complex programs
* Promotional terms and legal review deadlines, making sure nothing goes live without the right approvals in place
* Prize sourcing, ordering, and fulfillment tracking for sweepstakes and giveaways
* Facilitate and oversee Receipt Verification approval process, monitoring operations to ensure smooth program performance and reward delivery
* Documenting how we run programs, so the second one is easier than the first and the tenth is easy for anyone


### **What we're looking for**


* 3 to 5 years of project or program management experience, ideally in marketing, retail media, promotions, or agency environments
* A track record of running multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines and multiple stakeholders
* Comfort with promotional mechanics: sweepstakes, contests, rebates, loyalty offers, and the legal and operational requirements that come with them
* Strong written communication, because most of this job is making sure people know what is expected of them
* Someone who chases loose ends without being asked and follows up without being annoying
* Calm under pressure, and willing to raise a hand early when something is off track
* Experience with project management tools (ex: Atlassian, Asana or similar) and a bias toward making process simpler, not heavier


### **Nice to have**


* CPG or retailer experience, especially with Walmart, Target, Kroger, or Amazon programs
* Familiarity with loyalty platforms or shopper marketing programs
* Experience building a process from scratch rather than inheriting one
* CAPM or PMP certification

jobs.title: FEMA Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hagerty Consulting, Inc. (Hagerty) is the nation's leading emergency management and homeland security consulting firm. Known for its public spirit, innovative thinking, problem\-solving, and exceptional people, Hagerty is sought after to work on some of the largest and most complex crisis and emergency management issues. We serve our clients across the nation to enhance their preparedness programs; create more resilient and sustainable communities; provide innovative solutions to enhance their response; and obtain and manage grants and loans to support their recovery.


**This is not for immediate hire.** Candidates for the **FEMA** **Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager** position will be considered for our internal Recovery Cadre pipeline. Individuals we have added to this internal Recovery Cadre pipeline will receive first consideration for future openings that align with their skillset and interests. **If you are interested in active open positions where we would be looking at immediate hire, please review the other openings on our website.**  

  

The **FEMA** **Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager** will provide critical advisory and strategic planning services to our recovery clients and lead a large team. This position may be remotely based and include client travel as needed.  

  

**Responsibilities for the FEMA Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager Include:**


* Serve as a strong disaster recovery expert, with demonstrated experience supporting local governments through long\-term recoveries from natural disasters, with the ability to also act as a hands\-on project manager overseeing a dynamic and complex disaster recovery.
* Candidates will be expected to leverage their understanding of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Public Assistance (PA) Program \- Permanent Work (Categories C\-G), and how they can be strategically pursued and layered to address complex issues and needs in a post\-catastrophic disaster environment.
* Serve as a FEMA PA Program subject matter expert and be able to answer policy related questions within a reasonable, but necessary timeframe.
* Oversee a multi\-disciplinary team supporting all aspects of a recovery (e.g., cost recovery, infrastructure redevelopment, economic development, housing, social services, etc.), delegating tasks, assessing staffing needs and developing methodologies to meet unmet needs and maximize funding.
* Maintain strong project management best practices, ensuring the client has visibility on all efforts; deliverables are of the utmost quality; and upholding Hagerty’s core values of integrity, innovation, teamwork, and excellence within all efforts.


**Qualifications for the FEMA Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager Include****:**


* Prior support for local governments impacted by natural disasters through multiple federal disaster grant programs from the early onset of a disaster through grant obligation and closeout.
* A minimum of four years (4\) of experience in the FEMA PA Program, including, Permanent Work (Categories C\-G).
* Demonstrated experience managing complex and dynamic projects.
* High competency in written communication, including the ability to create nuanced/policy complex recommendation documents.
* Strong verbal communication skills, including the ability to present verbally to high level stakeholders.
* Previous experience managing workload for large multi\-disciplinary teams with varying levels of experience (i.e., junior level associates through senior subject matter experts).
* Strong proficiency with MS Office products, databases, and other software / technology platforms.
* A bachelor's degree.


**Compensation for FEMA Comprehensive Disaster Recovery Project Manager Includes:**


* Salary range of $115,000 \- $150,000\. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and training, licensure and certifications, internal equity, location, travel requirements, and other business and organizational needs.
* Comprehensive benefits program, including health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for health and transit/parking, short\- and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid time off, holidays, sick leave, and more.


Hagerty Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from a wide range of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity/national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, religion, age, disability, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other status, characteristic or condition protected by local, state, or federal law. We promote equal opportunity in all our employment decisions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, training, promotion, demotion, transfer, lay\-off and termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.


For our privacy notice to California residents regarding the collection of personal information, please click here.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Agfa HealthCare, is a division of the Agfa\-Gevaert Group which is headquartered in Mortsel, Belgium and traded on Euronext Brussels (AGFB).

We use our proven track record as an innovator, our in\-depth medical knowledge and our strategic guidance to help healthcare providers achieve their clinical, operational and business strategies.
