Founded in 1986, PCG employs approximately 2,000 professionals throughout the U.S.—all committed to delivering solutions that change lives for the better. The firm is a member of a family of companies with experience in all 50 states, and clients in three Canadian provinces and Europe. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit www.publicconsultinggroup.com .


Collaborating with our Technology Consulting team, you will help organizations streamline operations and achieve strategic goals to serve the public better. We provide the full spectrum of technology consulting services to help state and local agencies meet operational and program needs that enhance the lives of their user base.


Services:


* Strategy, Architecture, Planning, and Procurement
* Business Enablement
* Business Solutions
* Project Assurance

**Overall Responsibilities**  

We are currently seeking the services of full\-time Implementation Specialist to support our System Integration projects. If you are dynamic, mature, ambitious, creative, and autonomous, you will appreciate working with our team of technology professionals committed to providing value\-added services on our clients’ technology projects. As we are in the early phases of continuously improving and refining our product offerings, you’ll be faced with exciting challenges that require problem\-solving and innovation. If you're someone who enjoys tackling complex issues and thrives on the satisfaction of driving real change, this is the perfect opportunity for you to make a lasting impact.  



  

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Contribute to designing, configuring, and developing custom forms, templates, and workflows.
* Implement our Software as a Service (SaaS) platforms to best serve our clients.
* Configure client\-specific functionality to meet each client's unique requirements. This configuration will be performed using the SaaS platform tools, JavaScript, and other coding languages.
* Produce clean, efficient code based on defined functional and non\-functional specifications.
* Integrate software components and third\-party programs.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software.
* Gather, evaluate, and document customer use cases and business processes.
* Create technical documentation for reference and reporting.
* Understand low\-code platforms, relational database structures, and configuration methodologies.
* Contribute to the development of project reports such as Project Schedule, Quality Management Plan, Testing Plan, Conversion Plan, etc.
* Support the client and stakeholders in the planning and strategy discussions on the best approach for addressing risks and issues as they occur, in an effort to ensure that the project remains on schedule and within budget.
* Understand various software development life cycle methodologies and how they are used

Support business development initiatives, including RFP review and writing  

* 

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must have experience with COTS or SaaS solutions
* Must have experience in all system development life cycle phases using Agile, Waterfall, and/or Hybrid Agile approaches.
* Proficient in JavaScript or other common coding languages for system configuration, development, and troubleshooting.
* Familiar with JSON formatting and APIs, including how to implement and test them effectively

Participation in the implementation of integrated solutions to modernize legacy systems and/or mainframe technology through the development of n\-tier\-based solutions.  

* 

**Other Qualifications:**

* Software: MS Office (Project, Visio, Word, Excel, SharePoint)
* Other Software Tools: MS Visual Studio, JIRA, Postman
* Coding Languages: JavaScript, C\#, Python, or other common coding languages
* Technical: Service Oriented Architecture, TCP, FTP, SSH
* Databases: SQL, NoSQL, Oracle
* Methodologies: Waterfall, Agile, Scrum

Standards: PMBOK, CMMI, Prosci OCM, IEEE, SEI  

* 

  

**Desirable Certifications and Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in an IT or engineering field.
* Certified DevOps Project Manager (DevOps PM)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or SAFe Certified
* Certified Software Test Manager (CSTM)
* Certified AWS Cloud Practitioner

ITIL Certified  

* 

**Personal Attributes**

* Outstanding written and oral communication
* Highly self\-motivated and directed
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills
* Strong analytical skills and detail\-oriented
* Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment
* Strong work ethic and the ability to simultaneously support projects with multiple deadlines and a high degree of accuracy

Continuous learner  

* 

  

This position is hybrid with travel/onsite requirements. PCG is a remote\-friendly organization and is committed to creating a culture where remote work remains a vital part of the company’s success. To be successful in a remote work role at PCG, you must:


* be available during your set working hours
* have a safe, private, and distraction\-free environment in which to complete your work, and
* be able to give your full attention to the completion of your PCG job duties

Some travel to the office or elsewhere may be required for team meetings, client meetings, etc. We are accepting applications on an ongoing basis until filled.

new_jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, career and customer\-oriented **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** to join our team covering multiple properties in FL, VA, and MD.

  

The **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** will leverage their strong operational and supervisor background and facilities expertise to oversee physical facility operations, and equipment setups across regional sites while proactively making recommendations for improvement to achieve organizational and client needs.

 **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

  

* Managing daily facilities operations, maintenance activities, and related duties across multiple sites in Florida, Virginia, and Maryland.
* Ensuring the optimal utilization of the organization's facilities.
* Acting as the first point of contact for internal facilities issues, logging all maintenance, cleaning, and office/location services, and referring related issues to appropriate personnel.
* Assessing and evaluating physical space requirements of the organization and recommending plans to meet operational needs.
* Making recommendations for process, policy, and infrastructure improvements to effectively achieve organizational and client objectives.
* Accountable for team performance and results, adapting departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.
* Overseeing setup, installation, and proper functioning of specialized operational and facility equipment through ongoing inspection and maintenance.
* Traveling up to 75% across regional locations to support property oversight, technical integration, and on\-site training initiatives.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* High School Diploma/GED with 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in facilities operations, management, and staff hiring.
* Demonstrated expertise in facility setups and facility system maintenance across multi\-site properties.
* Experience overseeing computer and AV setups and assuring bandwidth capabilities of internet and IT infrastructure.
* Proven track record of evaluating facility operations and delivering recommendations to fulfill client and organizational objectives.
* Significant experience developing and conducting operational and/or staff training programs.
* Proven ability to work across large teams with multiple customers/clients and manage complex operational workflows.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 75% across regional locations (FL, VA, MD).

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, business, hospitality, or a related field.
* Experience overseeing planning through operational stages associated with opening or updating a facility.
* Self\-starter with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to drive operational changes across teams.
* Experience working within secure government contracting or facility environments hosting government teams.

 **Clearance Requirements:**

  

* US citizenship is required.

 **Physical Requirements:**

  

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* Needs to occasionally move about inside offices, mechanical spaces, and multi\-building properties, and must be able to move and inspect internal and external facilities details.
* Frequently communicates with co\-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

new_jobs.title: IT Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Scope:** The IT Operations Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day leadership, management, and execution of IT operations, including end user support, application support, EDI operations, business systems administration, and technology service delivery. The role directly supervises operational IT staff, serves as the primary escalation point for operational technology issues, and ensures the effective delivery of technology services across the organization.  

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Technology, the IT Operations Manager implements departmental priorities and operational initiatives while collaborating with Development, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to ensure technology services align with organizational needs. The role is responsible for fostering a high\-performing team environment, promoting cross\-functional collaboration, and maintaining operational excellence across supported systems and services.  

**Education:*** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Additional education or training in IT service management, systems administration, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, project management, leadership, or healthcare technology operations is desirable.

**Licensure/Certification Requirements:*** ITIL, Microsoft, CompTIA Security\+, Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or other relevant technology operations, service management, or leadership certifications preferred.
* Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity, cloud administration, and business systems administration certifications are desirable.

**Experience:*** Minimum of five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, service delivery, technical support, application support, systems administration, or related technology functions.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of supervisory, team leadership, or people management experience required.

* Experience supporting healthcare information systems, proprietary software solutions, client\-server environments, remote workforces, and regulated operational environments is desirable.
* Experience coordinating activities across business users, software development, cybersecurity, analytics, vendors, and client\-facing teams is preferred.
* Experience overseeing client implementations, EDI operations, business system administration, operational support services, and service delivery functions is highly desirable.
* Experience administering Microsoft 365 and supporting cloud\-based technology platforms, identity management, software licensing, and SaaS applications is preferred.
* Experience supporting Azure environments and coordinating with infrastructure teams, managed service providers, and technology vendors is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to lead operational teams, establish priorities, manage competing demands, and ensure successful execution of departmental objectives.

* Working knowledge of Azure administration, infrastructure operations, reporting solutions, SQL databases, Crystal Reports, and business application environments.
* Ability to translate business needs into operational requirements and coordinate activities between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Strong written, verbal, organizational, time management, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, develop, and manage technical staff while fostering accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build productive working relationships across Development, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Infrastructure, IT Operations, vendors, clients, and executive leadership.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences at all levels of the organization.
* Ability to handle complex situations tactfully, professionally, and diplomatically.
* Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products.

**IT Operations and Service Delivery*** Leads day\-to\-day IT operations, including help desk support, application support, service delivery, incident management, and operational technology administration.
* Ensures support requests, incidents, and operational issues are managed, prioritized, communicated, and resolved in accordance with established service expectations.
* Serves as the primary escalation point for operational technology issues affecting users, applications, systems, or business processes.
* Establishes and maintains operational procedures, support standards, documentation, and service delivery metrics.
* Monitors operational performance and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
* Ensures operational activities support departmental priorities established by the Vice President of Technology.

new_jobs.title: Vertical Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI\-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

  

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250\+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

  

The *Vertical Operations Manager* is accountable for the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This role ensures sales commitments are executable by Operations and delivered to customers reliably and efficiently within defined SLAs.

 **A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

**﻿**

* Operational Accountability: Ensure the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This includes delivering installations on time, maintaining SLA compliance, scaling delivery capacity, and achieving target costs.
* Delivery \& Support Ownership: Oversee all aspects of planning, resource allocation, safety compliance, and quality for installations, maintenance activities. Ensure installation targets are met: 2 days for Rental/Dealership installations and 4 days for Fleet installations. Ensure that maintenance (support visits) have a clear scope of work to complete on time, with a first time right approach.
* Sales\-Operations Interface: Act as the operational counterpart to the Sales and Implementation teams. This involves confirming the feasibility of sales commitments, identifying associated risks, and translating those commitments into concrete, executable operational plans.
* Field Service Leadership: Manager Field Service Engineers and Service Operations Coordinators, focusing on achieving 80% utilization, ensuring technical readiness, and developing productive capacity planning.
* Vendor Oversight: Manage installation partners and contractors. Responsibilities include continuously monitoring and evaluating vendor performance across key areas like cost, quality, and execution.
* KPI \& OKR Management: Proactively achieve critical operations metrics, including on\-time delivery, first\-time fix rates, and target cost per install, by implementing proactive corrective actions.

  

Requirements:
  

* 5\+ years of experience leading field operations, service delivery, or technical operations teams.
* Experience managing distributed Field Service Engineers (FSEs) or technical field teams.
* Experience in the automotive, fleet, rental, dealership, or a similar operational environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Operations.
* Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational forecasting.
* Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.
* Experience managing high\-volume deployment, installation, or field service projects.
* Experience managing third\-party vendors, contractors, and installation partners.
* Proficiency with ERP, CRM, or Field Service Management (FSM) systems to manage operations and drive performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven problem\-solving skills with the ability to make operational decisions using metrics.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certifications are a plus.
* Travel to on\-site locations based on business flow.

 **Benefits we offer:**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, Company paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

 **Compensation:**


UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $125,000\. In addition, this position is also eligible for Bonus.

 **Physical Requirements:**


This role may involve on\-site or field\-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; and performing occasional manual tasks such as lifting or carrying up to 40 lbs, bending, or reaching. The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

 **Why UVeye:**

* Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting\-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
* Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About Breaktime Media**


We help shoppers figure out what to buy and where to buy it. We build highly personalized, engaging content for the world's biggest CPG brands, with a focus on commerce conversion. Our work runs across retail media networks, brand sites, and loyalty ecosystems, and it reaches millions of shoppers making real decisions.


### **The role**


Breaktime is scaling, and our most ambitious work sits in promotions, loyalty hubs, retail media work and new innovation programs. We ran roughly 30 of these programs this year, they keep getting bigger, and the appetite from our brand partners is only growing. These are the programs that move the needle for our clients and for us.


We're building a dedicated program management role to match that ambition. You will own how these programs get executed: the plan, the deadlines, the dependencies, and the accountability that makes it all come together. Not the client relationship and not the creative, but the operating system across it all.


You will report to our Associate Director, Program Management, who will train you directly and work with you to build out a focused process and ramp you up on a set of programs. You will have real ownership from the start, and room to shape how this function works as we grow.


### **What you'll own**


* End to end program management for promotions, sweepstakes, loyalty hubs, omni retail media programs and custom programs that go beyond our standard content units
* Building and maintaining program timelines, from sold to live to wrap, with clear owners and dates at every step
* Task ownership across internal teams, so client services, creative, marketing and development all know what they owe and when
* Running program status meetings and keeping stakeholders honest about risk before it becomes a problem
* Partnering with client services on kickoff calls and status calls for our most complex programs
* Promotional terms and legal review deadlines, making sure nothing goes live without the right approvals in place
* Prize sourcing, ordering, and fulfillment tracking for sweepstakes and giveaways
* Facilitate and oversee Receipt Verification approval process, monitoring operations to ensure smooth program performance and reward delivery
* Documenting how we run programs, so the second one is easier than the first and the tenth is easy for anyone


### **What we're looking for**


* 3 to 5 years of project or program management experience, ideally in marketing, retail media, promotions, or agency environments
* A track record of running multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines and multiple stakeholders
* Comfort with promotional mechanics: sweepstakes, contests, rebates, loyalty offers, and the legal and operational requirements that come with them
* Strong written communication, because most of this job is making sure people know what is expected of them
* Someone who chases loose ends without being asked and follows up without being annoying
* Calm under pressure, and willing to raise a hand early when something is off track
* Experience with project management tools (ex: Atlassian, Asana or similar) and a bias toward making process simpler, not heavier


### **Nice to have**


* CPG or retailer experience, especially with Walmart, Target, Kroger, or Amazon programs
* Familiarity with loyalty platforms or shopper marketing programs
* Experience building a process from scratch rather than inheriting one
* CAPM or PMP certification

### **Company Description**


Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.


### **Team Description**


The Dropbox People Team is designing a workplace where every Dropbox employee can thrive. We take a human\-centered, HR as a Product approach—treating programs like well\-designed products shaped by employee and candidate needs, informed by data, and backed by actionable insights. Our team continuously innovates to attract, develop, and retain world\-class talent while building a culture of experimentation, craft, and community. From fostering connection in our Virtual First model to scaling HR systems and offering personalized learning tools and experiences, our work evolves to support the growth and needs of our people. We think big, act fast, and adapt with agility—grounded in outcomes, empathy, and clear communication.


### **Virtual First**


Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in\-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on\-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.


This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5\-10% of the year or 2\-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.


### **AI Fluency**


AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
We look for four key behaviors in candidates:
* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.  

  

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.

**What You'll Do**  
\- Plan and run delivery of interoperability and claims features: scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and release readiness.  
\- Run sprint ceremonies and backlog grooming with a distributed engineering team.  
\- Coordinate clearinghouse onboarding, payer and EDI enrollment, and trading partner testing.  
\- Report status to client leadership: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.  
\- Perform current\-state and gap analysis of billing, claims, and data\-exchange workflows in skilled nursing and senior living.  
\- Turn payer rules, companion guides, and Medicare/Medicaid policy into user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and data mappings.  
\- Define requirements across the claim lifecycle: eligibility (270/271\), authorization (278\), claim submission (837I/837P), acknowledgements (TA1, 999, 277CA), claim status (276/277\), and remittance (835\).  
\- Specify Medicare logic (Part A skilled stays, PDPM/HIPPS, consolidated billing, Part B, Medicare Advantage) and Medicaid logic (state variation, patient liability, managed Medicaid).  
\- Define coordination of benefits for dual\-eligible residents, plus denial management and A/R requirements (CARC/RARC, timely filing, aging).  
\- Gather requirements for Health Information Exchange (HIE) and apply Health Information Management (HIM) principles.  
\- Work with engineers on FHIR, HL7 v2, and C\-CDA data flows, and on the code sets that join clinical and billing data.  
\- Contribute to solution design with engineering: claim status model, denial and rework queues, remittance posting, and A/R reporting.  
\- Plan and run UAT with operational users and validate the implementation before release.

**Required Skills \& Experience**  
\- Bachelor's degree.  
\- 7\+ years of combined project management and business analysis experience, with at least 5 years in healthcare.  
\- Hands\-on medical claims processing with X12 transactions (837, 835, 276/277\) and their acknowledgements.  
\- Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid financials, including how Medicare and Medicaid coordinate for dual\-eligible patients.  
\- Experience with healthcare interoperability: HIE and HIM.  
\- Proven ability to write requirements engineers can build from: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data mappings.  
\- Agile delivery experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.  
\- Excellent communication with executives, clinicians, billing staff, and engineers.  
\- Must reside in the US and be authorized to work in the US. Excellent written and verbal English required.

**Strong Plus**  
\- Skilled nursing, long\-term care, post\-acute, or senior living experience (MDS 3\.0, PDPM, UB\-04, Medicaid patient liability).  
\- PointClickCare, MatrixCare, or similar long\-term care EHR/billing platforms.  
\- Clearinghouse experience (Availity, Waystar, Optum/Change Healthcare), including payer enrollment and trading partner testing.  
\- Working knowledge of FHIR R4, HL7 v2, and C\-CDA.  
\- Exposure to state Medicaid MMIS, managed Medicaid, or Medicare Advantage authorization workflows.  
\- PMP, CSM/PSM, CBAP, CRCR, CPB, RHIA, or RHIT.

**Work Conditions**  
\- Remote within the US; US business hours, working with a distributed engineering team.  
\- No travel expected.  
\- Protected health information is never placed in tickets, logs, screenshots, or sample files.

Our fax\-delivery suite of products allows our clients to exchange millions of patient information, insurance and other documents safely, swiftly and securely every business day. Concord’s use of Artificial Intelligence, analytics, and other cutting\-edge technology also analyzes the data being transferred within a fax, then delivers it into the right inboxes and workflows, fundamentally changing how data moves.

  

More than 2,300 healthcare organizations, financial providers, and companies in other equally document\-intensive industries trust Concord to deliver their confidential and sensitive information. We care about our customers, and with a retention rate of more than 98%, it’s clear they love the service and value we provide.

  

We have been in business since 1996 and growing faster than ever. Our products are getting smarter, our customers are getting bigger, and our user community is exploding. To continue meeting market demand and anticipating our customers’ needs, we are expanding our offerings. That means assembling a world\-class team to take us through this next phase of growth. We hope you’d like to join us!

 **About the role**


Concord is seeking a Senior Security Program Manager to bring structure, visibility , and
disciplined execution to our enterprise security program. Reporting to the CISO, this role
serves as the CISO's operational partner and leads Concord's security program
management office (PMO) function, acting as the connective tissue between security
strategy and execution across Concord's distributed security functions. In this role, you
will serve as Concord's: 1\) Security Program \& Portfolio Lead\- responsible for the
planning, coordination, and delivery of enterprise security , compliance, and customer
trust initiatives across the enterprise, and 2\) Security Governance \& Operations Lead\-
establishing the governance forums, processes, metrics, and financial management
practices that give leadership clear , credible, and timely insight into security program
performance, risk posture, and investment. This role requires strong program
management, facilitation, and communication skills, working knowledge of security and
compliance frameworks, and the ability to influence without direct authority in a
regulated healthcare technology environment. **Essential Functions:**

**Security Program \& Cross\-Functional Execution*** Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of enterprise security initiatives across Concord's distributed security functions, spanning strategic security , compliance, and customer trust priorities
* Own the integrated security roadmap and project portfolio, translating strategic objectives into sequenced milestones, workstreams, decision points, and measurable outcomes
* Manage project intake, prioritization, and scheduling for security initiatives, as well as IT and business\-owned projects with security interests
* Coordinate dependencies, handoffs, and critical path activities related to security initiatives across the enterprise, working with partner functions such as Technology, Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy , Compliance, Operations, and Finance

  

* Identify, track, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, and proactively escalate critical obstacles associated with all security\-related projects and initiatives
* Drive accountability and execution discipline across initiative owners and delivery partners without becoming the project manager for every individual effort

**Security Governance, Change Management \& Cross\-Functional Visibility*** Implement and lead a Security Change Advisory Board (CAB) to review , assess, and approve security\-relevant changes across Concord's environments
* Establish and facilitate security governance committees and leadership reviews, with clearly defined decision rights, escalation paths, and operating rhythms
* Maintain disciplined tracking of decisions and action items to ensure security priorities are effectively assessed, communicated, and managed
* Develop and maintain security metrics, KPIs/KRIs, and executive dashboards that provide actionable insight into security program performance, risk posture, compliance status, and progress against strategic initiatives
* Prepare EL T reporting, executive updates, and decision materials that synthesize complex program information into clear , concise narratives

**Security Process, Documentation \& Program Enablement*** Lead the development, standardization, and maintenance of security processes, procedures, standards, playbooks, RACI matrices, operating models, and program documentation across Concord's distributed security functions
* Establish consistent program management methodologies, reporting practices, and delivery expectations across security functions
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance consistency , accountability , scalability , operational efficiency , and overall security program maturity

**Cross\-Functional Security Planning, Budget \& Operational Management*** Support the CISO in the planning, coordination, and management of the security operating plan, vendor portfolio (including contracts, licensing, and renewals), resource allocation and capacity , and operational priorities

  

* Manage the security budget lifecycle in partnership with Finance, including annual planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and spend reporting, to provide financial visibility and accountability
* Coordinate annual and quarterly planning activities and help prioritize security investments and resources based on business objectives, risk, compliance requirements, and strategic priorities
* Develop business cases and ROI analyses to support security investment decisions and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets, program objectives, and organizational priorities

* Bachelor's degree in Informa

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Overview  
We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex infrastructure projects within the construction industry. This role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all phases of project execution, from initial planning through completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in construction management, excellent leadership skills, and proficiency with industry\-standard project management and construction software. Join our team to drive impactful projects that shape communities and infrastructure while advancing your career in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

* Lead project planning sessions to establish scope, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements using tools such as Primavera P6, Procore, and Microsoft Office.
* Develop detailed construction schedules and coordinate activities across multiple teams to ensure timely project delivery.
* Manage project budgets by monitoring costs, forecasting expenditures, and implementing cost control measures using HeavyBid and other cost management software.
* Oversee the preparation and review of construction plans, schematics, contracts, and regulatory compliance documentation to ensure adherence to all safety and construction regulations.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to facilitate seamless communication and project progression.
* Conduct site visits to monitor construction progress, verify quality standards, review blueprints and schematics, and ensure safety protocols are followed on\-site.
* Manage project documentation including change orders, RFIs (Requests for Information), daily reports, incident reports, and progress updates.
* Lead project teams by assigning tasks effectively, managing schedules with Primavera P6 or similar tools, and fostering a collaborative work environment focused on safety and excellence.

Experience

* Proven experience managing large\-scale infrastructure or commercial construction projects with a focus on civil or heavy civil works.
* Extensive knowledge of construction scheduling software such as Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project; experience with Procore or similar construction management platforms is highly desirable.
* Strong background in construction estimating, cost management, contract administration, and regulatory compliance specific to the construction industry.
* Demonstrated ability to read blueprints, schematics, and construction plans accurately while managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Hands\-on experience with construction site activities including safety inspections, quality assurance processes, and schedule coordination.
* Excellent leadership skills with a track record of managing diverse teams in fast\-paced environments while maintaining strict adherence to deadlines and budgets.
* Familiarity with industry standards such as OSHA regulations and local building codes is essential for success in this role.

Join us if you’re passionate about leading impactful infrastructure projects! We value proactive problem\-solving skills combined with a thorough understanding of construction processes—your expertise will help us build safer communities while advancing your professional journey in project management within the construction sector.

Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant Project Manager- Geotechnical
new_jobs.description:
Colliers Engineering \& Design is seeking a Laboratory Assistant Project Manager to support the day\-to\-day operations of our high\-volume Geotechnical and Construction Materials Testing Laboratory in Totowa, NJ. This role is ideal for a laboratory professional with strong geotechnical testing experience or a geotechnical engineer with experience in using testing data who is ready to take on greater leadership and project management responsibilities. Working alongside the Laboratory Manager, you'll assist with overseeing laboratory operations, manage testing programs, support staff development, coordinate multiple projects, and ensure quality, safety, and efficiency across the lab. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of technical work, team leadership, problem\-solving, and client interaction, while growing their career within a collaborative and expanding team. We are open to considering qualified candidates who are willing to relocate for this opportunity, and relocation assistance may be available for the right candidate.  

* Under the guidance of the Laboratory Manager, assists with efficient daily and long\-term management of the Geotechnical and Construction Material.
* Laboratory operations including but not limited to supervising staff working in the lab, training, maintenance of laboratory equipment, quality assurance, safety and productivity of the laboratory.
* Project management of multiple projects including budget control, control costs, staffing, testing and lookahead coordination.
* Manage, oversee, perform testing and submit testing results for rock, advanced, specialized and research testing which consists of the following testing but not limited to triaxial (UC, UU, CU, CD), direct shear, direct simple shear (DSS), cyclic DSS and triaxial, permeability, special mix testing (soil, cement, bentonite, etc.) and rock (slake, uniaxial, triaxial, shear).
* Generate, calculate and compile laboratory testing reports and issue to clients.
* Assist in maintaining and organizing the laboratory workload to meet given deadlines and proactive in assessing bottlenecks in workflows and processes to ensure efficient laboratory operations.
* Experience with MS Excel to generate lab testing reports is essential.
* Assist with entering lab units and billing information.
* Assist with overseeing and providing training for existing and entry\-level staff and maintains training documentation to ensure that all testing methods are performed in a safe and reliable manner.
* Assist with internal and external communication with outside clients and CED staff.
* Mechanically inclined to help with equipment trouble shooting and repairs is prefered.
* Assist with ensuring that lab is clean, organized and adequately stocked including but not limited to supply inventory, labeling and record keeping procedures.
* Assist with overseeing lab safety and lab SOP (standard operating procedures) including but not limited to proper specimen and chemical handling, disposal and storage processes and procedures.
* Communicating effectively and efficiently with contractors, clients and team members.
* Work Environment may include moderate to loud noise, dusty conditions, and require standing for extensive periods of time. Occasionally lifting and carrying objects weighing up to 40 lbs. Requires corrected vision, color perception and hearing to normal range.
* Weekend and overtime work is required as needed based on laboratory workload; some limited overnight and interstate travel may be required with this position.
* Performs other work\-related duties as assigned. The omission of specific responsibilities does not preclude the laboratory manager from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

  

* BA/BS in a related discipline (BS in civil engineering preferred) or equivalent experience.
* Experience in the Geotechnical Engineering field is preferred.
* Master’s degree or higher in a relevant area is preferred but not required.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred but not required.
* 5\+ years’ experience in geotechnical laboratory experience or geotechnical engineering.
* ACI Aggregate Base Testing Technician and NICET certifications are preferred. If you do not have the required certifications you will need to acquire them within 1 year of your start date.
* Experience in soil and rock laboratory work is preferred.
* MS Excel and Word.
* Geosystems experience.
* Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.


Compensation: $65,000 to $90,000 annually (depending on qualifications)

* Maintain and ensure compliance with industry regulations and safety standards.
* Communicate timely with vendors and contractors on bids and construction projects.


* Perform all other duties as assigned.


**Core Competencies**


* Communication: Ability to write and speak clearly and concisely


* Energetic: Ability to work with a sense of urgency and understand the importance of timely completion of projects and follow through


* Detail Oriented: Ability to understand the details of a project and the importance of details and accuracy in completing tasks


* Problem Solving Skills: Ability to find a solution for and to deal proactively with work\-related problems


* Decision Making: Ability to use good business judgement in making critical decisions


* Organized: Possessing the trait of following a systematic method of performing a task and maintaining an accurate record of the steps and documents involved


* Time Management: Ability to utilize the available time to organize and complete work within given timelines and work with a sense of urgency


* Self\-Motivated: Ability to be internally inspired to perform a task using one's own drive and initiative


* Honesty, Integrity and Reliable: Ability to be truthful, credible and dependable in the workplace. Do what you say.


* Motivation: Ability to inspire others to reach a goal and to perform to the best of their ability.


**Role Qualifications / Skills/ Abilities**


* Associate or bachelor's degree in construction technology, Construction Management or equal from an accredited college or university.


* Certified Construction Management (CCM) or Project Management (PMP) a plus.


* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience managing multiple construction projects of increasing size and complexity in mutli\-family, residential development and or commercial construction as a Project Manager or Owner's representative managing similar construction projects.
* Must be able to pass a drug and background screening.


* Efficiently operates assigned computer software and other equipment, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Microsoft Project and project management software systems.


* Must have valid drivers license and satisfactory driving record.


**Work Environment**


* This position is remote and will require 30% to 60% travel.

* Competitive Compensation

* Medical, Dental, Vision with additional ancillary options

**Our Newest Opportunity:**

**Summary:**


The Business Analyst (BA) supports a broad range of D365\-focused work for OneDigital’s Employee Benefits and Human Resources Consulting practices, partnering with teams across Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Service, and more. Responsibilities may vary based on business priorities, production needs, and larger product initiatives.  



  

The BA serves as the primary owner of small to medium\-sized enhancements and User Stories, from requirements through delivery, allowing Product Owners and Product Managers to stay focused on larger strategic initiatives. The BA also supports those larger initiatives as needed, gathering and documenting requirements, refining backlog items, coordinating demos and user acceptance testing (UAT), analyzing production issues, and partnering with technical teams on system behavior, integrations, dependencies, and impacts.  



  

To be successful, this individual must demonstrate strong business analysis skills, technical aptitude, and a personable, relationship\-driven approach, with the ability to move fluidly between business and technical conversations. The BA is also AI\-enabled by design, using AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Copilot and Claude in daily delivery, documentation, analysis, and communication.  



  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


**Role Scope \& Balance**

* Serve as the primary owner of small to medium\-sized backlog items, including standalone User Stories, operational enhancements, and production fixes, allowing Product Owners and the Product Manager to stay focused on larger strategic initiatives.
* Support a flexible mix of D365 business analysis, application support, and product delivery work across multiple business areas.
* Adapt to shifting business priorities, production needs, and the size or complexity of active initiatives.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder reviews.

**Enhancements \& Modifications**


* Own the analysis and delivery of small to medium\-sized D365 enhancements and User Stories, from requirements through release.
* Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, translating business needs into clear User Stories and acceptance criteria.
* Develop current\-state and future\-state process flows, business rules, and supporting documentation.
* Validate requirements for completeness, clarity, testability, and alignment to business outcomes.
* Perform impacFt analysis on requested changes, confirming that updates to fields, forms, processes, or configuration won't disrupt other business units, reporting, integrations, or downstream processes.
* Write release notes that clearly describe delivered changes for business users.

**Initiative \& Feature Support**


* Support Product Owners and the Product Manager on larger Features and Epics as needed, typically by taking on User Stories within that work.
* Contribute requirements analysis, process documentation, stakeholder engagement, and UAT coordination to larger initiatives, while ownership of Features and Epics remains with the Product Owner.

**Demos \& UAT**


* Coordinate demos with requestors before UAT to confirm the solution meets the business need.
* Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), including test scenarios, tester coordination, issue tracking, and sign\-off.
* Document UAT outcomes and follow through on any issues or changes identified during testing.

**Application \& Integration Support**


* Investigate D365 production issues, including business impact assessment, reproduction, and documentation, before escalating to technical teams.
* Determine whether an issue is a system defect, a process or training gap, or a new requirement.
* Partner with developers and architects on enhancements and issues involving D365 integrations, clarifying data flows, dependencies, and expected system behavior.

**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication**


* Coordinate with the Product Owner before engaging business stakeholders, and keep the Product Owner informed of relevant conversations, decisions, and next steps.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, Product Owners, the Product Manager, and technical teams, serving as a trusted liaison between them.
* Translate system behavior and technical concepts into clear, business\-friendly communication.
* Support stakeholder follow\-up, training, and documentation updates after release.

**AI\-Enabled Delivery**


* Use Copilot, Claude, or similar LLMs to draft and refine requirements, User Stories, acceptance criteria, meeting notes, and stakeholder communications.
* Use AI\-assisted techniques to identify requirement gaps, edge cases, inconsistencies, and test scenarios.
* Review all AI\-generated output for accuracy, completeness, and security, and follow data privacy standards, including safeguarding PHI and PII.

**Business Analysis \& Technical Skills**


* Strong requirements gathering, documentation, and process analysis skills.
* Ability to analyze production issues and enhancement requests with clear attention to business impact.
* Experience support

new_jobs.description:
**The Company**

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech\-enabled, but we're ultimately human\-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry\-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top\-notch job offers received every year and a near\-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.**Job Title:** People Operations Associate (End\-to\-End HR Generalist)


**Location:** Bengaluru (Remote)


**Experience:** 3–5 Years


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


### **About Springboard**



At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in allied health, data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech\-enabled, but we're ultimately human\-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry\-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches to successfully transition students into their dream jobs. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top\-notch job offers received every year and a near\-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.


### **Role Overview**



Reporting directly to the Global Head of People Operations, you will serve as the primary People Operations partner for Springboard’s India entity. In this high\-visibility role, you will bridge global HR strategy with local execution, managing the full employee lifecycle, ensuring operational alignment across global teams, and driving a seamless employee experience for our India\-based workforce.


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Global\-to\-India HR Alignment \& Operations**


* Serve as the India People Operations partner, working closely with India and the US teams to roll out talent initiatives, policies, and systems.
* Work as the primary People Operations point of contact for India employees, managing day\-to\-day employee queries and coordinating with managers, Finance, IT, global People Operations, and external vendors.
* Maintain accurate employee data, HRIS records (e.g., Rippling), employment changes, compensation updates, employee documentation, periodic HRIS data audits, leave management, and attendance systems.
* Coordinate India payroll, including preparation and validation of payroll inputs, new\-joiner details, leave impacts, compensation changes, reimbursements, and final review with Finance/payroll partners to ensure accurate, timely monthly disbursement.
* Maintain operational and compliance trackers covering statutory requirements, insurance, contracts, renewals, audits, and other recurring People Operations deadlines.

#### **2\. Full\-Cycle Talent Acquisition**


* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for India\-based roles across tech, product, and business ops.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop structured screening criteria, interview scorecards, competency assessments, and candidate evaluation processes.
* Manage recruitment activities including application review, sourcing via LinkedIn or other job boards, employee referrals, screening calls, candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling across time zones, candidate communication, hiring\-manager follow\-ups, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff.
* Maintain accurate recruitment pipelines and reporting through Greenhouse and other sourcing platforms.

#### **3\. Onboarding \& Employee Experience**


* Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for India, including preboarding, onboarding, employment changes, promotions, employee documentation, and offboarding.
* Drive culture\-building initiatives, team offsites, virtual All teams meeting etc.
* Coordinate onboarding readiness across People Ops, IT, and hiring managers, including HRIS setup, documentation, equipment/access provisioning, orientation, and new\-hire check\-ins.
* Conduct stay and exit interviews, analyze attrition data, and manage the complete offboarding activities, including asset recovery, IT/access removal, and the full \& final (F\&F) settlement process.

#### **4\. Compliance \& Workplace Relations**


* Draft, review, implement, and communicate India People policies, updating them in response to business requirements and changes in employment legislation.
* Ensure strict compliance with Indian labor laws (Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESIC, POSH, Gratuity).
* Manage People\-related vendors and coordinate with payroll, insurance, legal, IT, background verification, training, and other external partners.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances, maintaining high confidentiality, empathy, and workplace safety.

### **What We Are Looking For**


* **Experience:** 3–5 years of hands\-on, end\-to\-end HR generalist experience in a fast\-growing startup or tech environment.
* **Education:** MBA / Master’s degree in Human Resources or related field preferred.
* **Core Competencies:**
* + Demonstrated track record across talent acquisition, HR ops, and employee engagement.
	+ Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, PF, ESI, POSH, and basic payroll mechanics.
	+ Proficiency with HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling, Darwinbox) and ATS tools (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever).
* **Soft Skills:**
* + High ownership, bias for action, and ability to handle ambiguity in a matrixed setup.
	+ Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
	+ Empathy, confidentiality, and strong interpersonal relationship\-building capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Lead Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.


**So, what’s the role all about?**


After key customers have purchased and are implementing our products, the Technical Account Management (TAM) team takes ownership of the customer relationship and becomes their advocate within NiCE. The Technical Account Manager (TAM) begins to engage with the customer before they go live on the contact center platform, and works closely with the customer from that point forward to ensure their success.


Our TAMs are seasoned account management and technical resolution professionals who are at the top of their field and are unified in exceeding customer expectations, improving our processes and technology, and meeting company growth objectives. The Lead TAM is a deeply experienced and expert account management professional, responsible for resolving the most complex problems and providing excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts. TAM will help customers overcome issues that arise, succeed in their business using our technology and services, expand their usage of our products, be a reference to prospective customers, and be a long\-term and loyal customer. The accounts assigned are generally our largest, most complex, and challenging customers.


**How will you make an impact?**


* Take ownership of the customer relationship for key CX customers and become their advocate within CX, engaging before go\-live and working closely with customers to ensure their success.
* Resolve the most complex problems and provide excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts, including resolving technically and emotionally challenging and high\-stakes issues.
* Exemplify an effective and productive relationship with assigned accounts, holding regular discussions to review open issues, understand their contact center and business, ensure CX solutions meet their needs, and become a trusted partner and advisor.
* Ensure all technical challenges, issues, cases, and requests are handled properly and within SLA targets by partnering with Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering.
* Be accountable for customer satisfaction, retention, and referenceability for all assigned accounts.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 10 years in a Technical/Service role in software, telecommunications or in customer service, call/contact center and/or service delivery
* Demonstrated technical problem solving proficiency
* Excellent analytical and advanced troubleshooting skills with end\-users/customers
* Working technical knowledge of contact center software/design/functionality
* Implementation: broad skills in both technology \& analysis; experience in communicating at a technical and functional level while managing business rapport

**You will have an advantage if you also have:**


* TCP/IP networking knowledge and VoIP technology exposure
* Comprehensive knowledge of TCP/IP, telecom circuits from DS0 through OC\-48
* Understanding of network topology and telecommunications architecture (PBX, Carriers and VoIP)
* Understanding of basic scripting fundamentals
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP and internet fundamentals
* Extensive software, telecommunications and IP Telephony
* Experience using SIP signaling
* Competent in database and SQL concepts and scripting
* Desired personal profile: analytical, inquisitive, service \& team\-oriented, friendly demeanor, early adopter

**What’s in it for you?**


Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!


*This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.*
  

*This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.*

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

new_jobs.description:

None

Functional Requirements



##### **REQ\#:****RQ226716**


##### **Public Trust:****Other**


##### **Requisition Type:****Regular**


##### **Your Impact**


Own your opportunity to work alongside federal civilian agencies. Make an impact by delivering solutions that improve citizen services millions depends on.


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Senior Business Analyst**

  

  

The Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) develop a modern cloud\-based solution to support all federal courts across the United States which are grouped into three types namely, Appellate, District, and Bankruptcy. This modernized case management system will eventually replace the current Case Management and Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system.


The Sr Business Analyst will work as part of an agile development team to build and support the modernization of enterprise\-class software applications.

  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Participate in all Agile Scrum ceremonies, program planning meetings, to establish and document customer journey mapping strategies for the CMM Program.
* Take ownership of the Backlog decomposition strategy and ensure consistent implementation across the product backlog.
* Work closely with the customer to ensure alignment with their expectations while ensuring strict control of Scope.
* Provide transparency throughout the backlog decomposition process using up\-to\-date metrics and automated dashboards.
* Provide a clear Definition of Done and Definition of Ready and ensure strict compliance across all work items.
* Ensure a healthy prioritized backlog of work items ‘ready for sprint’ (at least 4 sprints worth) for each development team.
* Proactively participate in PI planning and provide clarity on deliverables, dependencies, milestones, timelines and sequencing of tasks.
* Work closely with Fed BA’s and Product Owners to promptly resolve impediments and clarify requirements with the customer in a timely manner.
* Conduct periodic retrospectives and/or CoP meetings with BAs to collect feedback, identify areas for continual improvement and cross\-train staff.
* Tirelessly pursue opportunities for streamlining and improving the efficiency of the end\-to\- end process as it pertains to product quality, alignment with requirements and most importantly customer satisfaction.
* Proactively identify and manage risks.
* Promptly identify and communicate mitigations plans.
* Address issues promptly and follow up diligently until they are resolved.
* Collaborate closely with the Architects, Testers, PO’s and stakeholders to ensure end\-to\-end alignment with the deliverables.
* Update and maintain process maps utilizing Microsoft Visio to provide visual depiction of the business process flows as well as flows at the subprocesses with two\-level depth.
* Develop narratives that accompany business process flows at each level articulating the details of each activity and with the business and technical data flowing between each activity on the process flows.
* Participate in process flow mapping and analysis sessions with CMM Backlog team and Court staff.
* Capture input from stakeholders, analyze the opportunities for standardization versus required variations among Court types, unique local rules, and any other variations.
* Validate completed work items to ensure they satisfy all requirements and aspects of the definition of done and free of errors/omissions.
* Support Manual and automation testers to design appropriate test cases and test steps for thorough validation of work items.
* Maintain process flow and narratives in an easily accessible, hierarchical fashion so that an end\-user can drill down a given process map at each level.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**


* Experience supporting multiple teams and ensuring the overall objective is met.
* Experience analyzing, decomposing and documenting detailed requirements (including but not limited to consulting with product owners, customers, key stakeholders, or end users).
* Experience developing requirements into technical user stories with clearly documented Definition of Done and acceptance criteria.
* Experience assisting the Product Owner or Team lead in defining the product scope, vision, and roadmap.

Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits.


  
**Company Overview**
====================


Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.


**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================


At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.


Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.


Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\.


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


Deepgram is looking for a **Privacy Operations Lead** to own the operational backbone of our privacy program. Deepgram processes audio — often some of the most sensitive data our customers hold — across several deployment models: hosted with model\-improvement opted in, hosted with model\-improvement opted out (effectively zero data retention), single\-tenant Deepgram Dedicated deployments with regional data residency, and fully self\-hosted deployments running in the customer's own environment. Our hosted services run primarily on our own bare\-metal infrastructure in colocation datacenters, with AWS used for overflow capacity and a small set of services — so knowing where data actually lives means knowing our datacenters, not just a cloud console.


You will be the person who knows, in operational detail, how data moves through each of those models — and who turns that knowledge into durable artifacts: data flow maps, records of processing, assessment templates, playbooks, and self\-service guidance that Legal, Engineering, and Sales Engineering can use without re\-deriving the answer every time. You will also be the technical voice in enterprise customer privacy reviews.


This is not a policy\-writing job. Roughly half the work is assessment and advisory; the other half is designing and operating the processes and tooling that make our privacy claims repeatable and verifiable. Where verification requires reading code or inspecting infrastructure, you will define what needs to be proven and partner with Security and Engineering to prove it — you are not expected to do that engineering work yourself.


This role reports to the Director of Information Security and works closely with Legal, Engineering, and Solutions/Sales Engineering.


We are open on level. This is a senior individual\-contributor role, and we will calibrate title, scope, and compensation to demonstrated experience.


**About Deepgram**
------------------


Deepgram builds foundational voice AI — speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, and voice agent infrastructure — used by enterprises and developers to build production voice applications at scale. Our models are trained and served on our own infrastructure, and we offer hosted, dedicated single\-tenant, and self\-hosted deployment options so customers can meet their own data residency and retention requirements. Learn more at deepgram.com.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own customer and prospect privacy risk assessments, DPIAs, and transfer impact assessments end to end. Be the technical voice in customer privacy reviews and vendor due diligence calls.
* Build and maintain accurate data flow maps and records of processing across hosted, dedicated, and self\-hosted deployments — including which datacenter, region, or cloud each flow touches — and own the process that keeps them accurate as the product changes.
* Translate GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and other US state privacy laws, and emerging AI regulation (EU AI Act, state AI and automated decision\-making rules) into concrete requirements that engineering and GTM teams can act on, rat
